mechanics.definition: The 🔥 number (App.jsx:535 `streak = recovery.consistencyStreak`, shown in the header pill App.jsx:805-813 and the Home strip HomePage.jsx:218-223) counts ELIGIBLE days in the current unbroken run, through today. A day is one training day: 03:00 local to 03:00 the next morning (src/day.js:20, 32-39). A day is eligible if (a) at least one session was saved on it, or (b) the rolling recovery cycle scheduled it as rest, whether or not you trained (src/recovery.js:200-203). The run starts the day after the last unpaid miss, or the day after a settings-change reset (src/recovery.js:229, 235-240), and counts only eligible days from there (src/recovery.js:296-307). Inside the run, a day paid for with a rest credit holds the run but adds 0 (src/recovery.js:298-300). Today is in the number only once it qualifies. A scheduled rest day counts from 03:00, the moment the day begins. A workout day counts only once a session is saved. An unfinished workout day is 'pending': it neither adds nor breaks (src/recovery.js:237-238, 291; tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:333-341). So 'streak 30' means 30 days on which you did what the plan asked (trained, or had a plan rest). It is not 30 calendar days, and not 30 sessions. Any frozen (paid) days are extra calendar days on top. The value is derived fresh from hf_sessions + hf_recovery on every render and is never stored (src/recovery.js:265-267).

rules.rule: The day turns at 03:00 local, not midnight. A session belongs to the day it STARTED: session.date is stamped at start and never rewritten. A session started at 01:30 counts for the previous evening's day.
rules.evidence: src/day.js:20, 32-39; App.jsx:367, 392 (date set in startPlannedWorkout/startWorkout); tests/day.test.mjs:16-30; tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:471-482

rules.rule: A day counts as 'trained' if at least one SAVED session falls on it. One session is enough, and extra sessions add nothing. A session is saved on «إنهاء التمرين» unless normalizeSession returns null. It needs at least one ticked set, OR (when nothing is ticked) at least one set with weight>0 and reps>0. Planned sets come pre-filled with the suggested weight and reps, so finishing an untouched planned workout for a lift with history still saves and counts. An empty session is discarded with a toast «الجلسة فاضية… فما انحفظت».
rules.evidence: src/recovery.js:110 (workoutDates from all sessions); src/sets.js:44-56; App.jsx:401-416; utils.js:295-299 (blankSet pre-fills weight+reps); progression.js:98 (suggestedReps defaults to target.base); tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:455-465

rules.rule: A workout in progress does not count. hf_sessions only changes in finishSession, so the streak cannot include today until the session is finished.

Which days are workout days and which are rest comes from a ROLLING cycle tied to weekly frequency, not to weekdays. 3/wk=[1], 4/wk=[2], 5/wk=[3,2] (default), 6/wk=[3,3]. After N consecutive trained days the next day is a scheduled rest day. A frequency change applies from today forward and is never retroactive.
A scheduled rest day is eligible (+1) whether or not you train. It is added at 03:00 when the day begins, with nothing to do.
rules.evidence: src/recovery.js:201; tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:27-34, 52-58; probe: 3/wk, trained days 1,3,5, on the morning of day 6 the streak is already 6

rules.rule: Training on a scheduled rest day gives +1 and does not reset the cycle: the rest is pushed to the next day.
«أشعر أنني قادر على التمرين» (override) only changes how today is displayed (status WORKOUT). The day is still judged as a free scheduled rest, so skipping training afterwards costs nothing.

A past workout day with no saved session is a MISS. When that day closes at 03:00, the engine checks the run's usable balance (earned − spent). If the balance is ≥1, a credit is spent automatically: the streak stays put (+0) and the cycle freezes. If not, the run ends: the streak restarts at 0 the next day and the credits go back to 0. Two banked credits absorb two misses; the third miss breaks the streak.
Today is never a miss and is never charged, however late it is, until 03:00 passes.
Rest credits are EARNED automatically: one for every 5 eligible days in the current run. Paid days count neither toward the streak nor toward progress. A credit lands on exactly the 5th eligible day.

Rest credits are SPENT automatically. The user has no way to spend or save one: there is no 'take rest' button, and the only code that writes restDays is the effect that records what the engine already auto-paid. It shows a one-time toast «استُخدم يوم راحة من رصيدك عن … — ستريكك مجمّد لا مكسور».
rules.evidence: App.jsx:505-530 (sole writer of restDays besides backup import App.jsx:990); grep restDays in src/; TodayHero.jsx:244-276 (no rest action)

rules.rule: MAX_REST_CREDITS=5 caps the DISPLAY only. Spending reads the uncapped earned − spent, so someone who has earned 8 is shown 5, the 5 stays on screen through the first 3 spends, and up to 8 misses are absorbed.
rules.evidence: src/recovery.js:60, 239 (uncapped) vs 312, 318 (Math.min clamp); tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:88-100 only checks the displayed value; probe: 40-day run, displayed credits stay 5 for 3 spends, streak survives 8 straight misses

rules.rule: Breaking the streak also zeroes the credit balance, because credits belong to a run. A day already paid for stays paid even if the run breaks later.

Changing frequency or plan: one change every 30 days is free and keeps the streak. A second change inside that window sets streakResetAt=today, so the streak reads 0 at once (today excluded even if you trained) and credits reset too. The confirm dialog states the cost.

Deload does NOT protect the streak. The plan still runs, and a missed day in a deload still spends a credit or breaks the streak. (The brief's claim that deload weeks protect the streak is wrong for this code.)
rules.evidence: src/deload.js:2-4; monthReport.js:269-273; recovery.js never reads config.deload; tests/deload.test.mjs:9-10

rules.rule: «تخطي اليوم» only moves the plan to its next day. The streak engine still expects a workout, so at 03:00 the skipped day costs a credit or breaks the streak.
The replay is capped at 400 days, so a streak longer than about 401 days cannot be represented.
Restoring a backup only keeps the streak if the backup carries hf_recovery (frequency history, paid days). Older backups are judged against whatever the device is configured with now.

states.when: No saved sessions (computeRecovery's early return), status WORKOUT, streak 0. The header pill and strip number are hidden because streak > 0 is required; all 5 flames are dim.
states.todayNeeds: Finish and save any session to start at 1.
states.deadline: Nothing to lose yet; today counts if a session is saved before 03:00.

states.when: status WORKOUT, nothing saved today, usable balance (earned − spent) ≥ 1.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing strictly. Train for +1. If not, one credit is auto-spent and the streak is frozen (+0). The UI gives no advance notice of this; only the 🎟️N chip in the hero.
states.evidence: src/recovery.js:238-239; TodayHero.jsx:199-207; HomePage.jsx:152-153 (no warning when credits > 0)

states.when: status WORKOUT, nothing saved today, balance 0, streak 1–4. With fewer than 5 eligible days no credit can exist yet.
states.todayNeeds: Save a session or the streak breaks to 0. No warning is shown, because atRisk requires a streak of 5 or more.

states.when: status WORKOUT, balance shown as 0, streak ≥ 5 (HomePage atRisk).
states.todayNeeds: Save a session or the streak and credits go to 0. Red line in the collapsible summary row: «لا رصيد راحة — إن لم تتمرّن اليوم ينكسر ستريكك»; inside the fold: «…(N يوم)».
states.deadline: 03:00 local tomorrow morning (never stated in the UI)

states.when: A session dated today (03:00–03:00) is saved, status COMPLETED.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing. Today is already +1. The hero still shows «يوم تمرين» + «ابدأ التمرين» for the next plan day, because TodayHero only gets isRecoveryDay. If credits are 0 and streak ≥ 5, the red «إن لم تتمرّن اليوم ينكسر ستريكك» still shows (false alarm).
states.evidence: src/recovery.js:171, 182; HomePage.jsx:130-131, 152-153, 182-199; probe A: trained today, 0 credits, atRisk=true

states.when: status RECOVERY: the cycle's own rest day.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing. Already +1 since 03:00. Hero reads «اليوم للراحة · لن يُحتسب غياباً ولن يكسر الستريك» and the summary reads «اكتملت الدورة — اليوم للتعافي».

states.when: Today is in overrides (tapped «أشعر أنني قادر على التمرين»), status WORKOUT, but the day is still judged a scheduled rest.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing. Training is optional and +1 is already counted. If credits are 0 and streak ≥ 5, the red at-risk line shows anyway (false alarm).

states.when: hf_active is set (workout in progress). Hero shows «جلسة شغّالة / أكمل التمرين».
states.todayNeeds: Press «إنهاء التمرين» with at least one ticked set, or one set with weight+reps. Until then today is not counted.
states.deadline: Session start time must fall before 03:00; it is then filed to the day it started.

states.when: Most recent paid day is within 7 days (restTakenHistory). Summary row turns gold.
states.todayNeeds: Depends on the underlying day state. The notice names only the LAST paid day: «غبت <Hijri date> — دُفع من رصيدك، وستريكك سليم». The greeting uses the creditSpent pool if yesterday was the paid day.

states.when: Several consecutive workout days auto-paid. The streak number does not move for days. Veteran fixture: 10 days since last session, 8 straight paid days, still 🔥60, 4 credits shown (12 earned).
states.todayNeeds: Train to start adding again. Each further miss silently spends another credit until none are left, then the streak breaks.
states.evidence: src/recovery.js:238-239, 298-300; probe veteran.mjs; screenshots/page-home.png, state-recovery-open.png (comeback greeting beside 🔥60)

states.when: A past miss with no usable balance. Streak 0 (or 1 if today is a scheduled rest), credits 0, brokenBy = that date.
states.todayNeeds: Save a session to start again. The UI says nothing about the break: the pill just disappears, and brokenBy/missedDays are never shown on Home.
states.evidence: src/recovery.js:229, 240, 329-330; App.jsx:805; grep brokenBy (no UI reader)

states.when: streakResetAt == today, after a second frequency or plan change inside the 30-day window.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing can recover today. The streak shows 0 even if you trained today and builds again from tomorrow. Toast: «تم التغيير — بدأ ستريك جديد».

states.when: deloadState.active (rides on top of any state above).
states.todayNeeds: Same as the underlying state. The streak is NOT protected. Flames become droplets, and the deload greeting outranks comeback, creditSpent and streak lines.

states.when: Today is in restDays on a workout day. Only reachable through an imported backup or legacy data: no current code writes today into restDays.
states.todayNeeds: Nothing. The day is 'paid': holds the streak, costs one credit.

daysSinceLastWorkout and daysSinceLastRest. src/recovery.js:351-352

Commitment tier for a streak (label, flame count 0–5, colour; thresholds 0/1/3/7/14/30). constants.js:218-225; utils.js:421-427
STREAK_MILESTONES (7,10,14,21,30,40,50,60,75,90,100,120,150,180,200,250,300,365), so the next milestone and days to it can be derived. utils.js:630
unlockedAt timestamps for the streak achievements c1–c6 (3/7/14/30/60/100 eligible days): when each threshold was first reached. App.jsx:135, 300-318; constants.js:792-822

Month report consistency: trainedDays, scheduledRests, paidRests, missedDays, calendar kinds, endStreak, end-of-month restCredits, and streaks.month/prevMonth/allTime/carried {days, span, start, end, ongoing}. These runs are in SESSION units, not 🔥 units. monthReport.js:209-278
hf_history_restore_report {count, dates}: the sessions the 30→6 repair brought back. App.jsx:92-96; RestLedgerPanel.jsx:77-93
confusions: The header 🔥N carries no state. It reads the same whether today is already counted, still pending, frozen by credits, at risk, or a free scheduled rest. At 0 it disappears, so a break is silent: brokenBy is computed but never shown (App.jsx:805-813; HomePage.jsx:218-223; recovery.js:330).

A frozen streak can sit unchanged for many days. Veteran capture: 10 days since the last session, 8 straight auto-paid days, still 🔥60, while the greeting says «الغياب انتهى لحظة ما فتحت التطبيق» (comeback pool, utils.js:637). Same in screenshots/page-home.png, page-profile.png and state-recovery-open.png.

The 5-credit cap is cosmetic. Earned credits keep accruing uncapped (recovery.js:239 vs 318), so the chip stays at 5 while credits are being spent. The spend notice then says «بقي لك 5 أرصدة», which looks like nothing was spent. The month-report tip says a full balance «يضيع» (monthReport.js:640), which is false.
The spend notice and the summary line name only the most recent paid day (HomePage.jsx:145-147, 294, 384). In state-recovery-open.png, eight paid days read as a single «غبت الثلاثاء، ٢٢ محرم».

Paid-day dates use fmtDate with the ar-SA locale, so they come out Hijri with Arabic-Indic digits («٢٦ محرم», utils.js:94-103; overlay-system-alert.png). Elsewhere the app uses Western digits, and the ledger uses ISO Gregorian dates.

The at-risk warning is wrong both ways. It checks only !isRecoveryDay (HomePage.jsx:152-153), so it fires after you have trained today and on an override day. It is silent for streaks 1–4, where a miss also breaks the streak. It never names the 03:00 deadline. It sits in a collapsible row under the hero, not by the CTA or the flame (HomePage.jsx:274-304; state-credit-warning.png).
There is no advance notice that skipping a workout day will spend a credit. The spend is only explained afterwards (HomePage.jsx:378-390).

The hero has no 'done today' state. TodayHero gets only isRecoveryDay (HomePage.jsx:182-199), so after a saved session it still offers «ابدأ التمرين» for the next plan day. Nothing on Home confirms that today counted; only a toast and the 'done' greeting do.
The number goes up at different moments. A scheduled rest day adds +1 at 03:00 with no action. A workout day adds only when the session is finished, not when it is started (App.jsx:440-453).

There are four different 'streak' numbers: (1) Header/Home = eligible days, including plan rests. (2) Report and poster «أطول سلسلة» = training days only (monthReport.js:175-178; Consistency.jsx:66-74; reportPoster.js:190). A perfect 30-day month on 5/wk reads Home 30 vs report 22, and the report ignores settings resets (Home 10 vs report 22, probe). The code comments falsely say the two match (monthReport.js:153-157; Consistency.jsx:66-68). (3) Profile «أفضل streak» is just the current streak (ProfilePage.jsx:72, 431). (4) The recovery card puts «تمارين متتالية» (workoutStreak, resets every rest day) beside «أيام التزام» (HomePage.jsx:433-456; ProfilePage.jsx:416-417).
«تخطي اليوم» says «تم تخطي يوم التمرين», which sounds excused, but the engine still expects a workout that day (App.jsx:382-385).

Deload looks protective but is not. The flames turn into calm droplets (HomePage.jsx:103-121), and the deload greeting outranks the credit-spent and comeback lines (utils.js:636). Yet a missed deload day still spends a credit or breaks the streak (deload.js:3-4).
A break also wipes the credit balance (recovery.js:229), with no explanation. A settings reset shows 0 even straight after a workout (recovery.js:235).
Paid days freeze the streak (+0) rather than adding to it. The only explanation, «يجمّد ستريكك بلا زيادة ولا كسر», is inside the collapsed card (HomePage.jsx:368-370).

The words drift: ستريك / أيام التزام / سلسلة / «streak» in Latin script / الـstreak. Credits are called رصيد راحة / أيام راحة اختيارية / أرصدة / 🎟️, never «تذاكر» (grep). Colours drift too: 'أيام التزام' and credits are gold (HomePage.jsx:351-425, 447-450; TodayHero.jsx:204; ProfilePage.jsx:417), against Floodlight's orange-for-streak and blue-for-rest roles.

The only place that explains how the number was reached (and the 30→6 repair) is Settings › «سجل المكافأة (تشخيص)». It is a developer table with English keys such as consistencyStreak (RestLedgerPanel.jsx:53-56, 77-93; restLedger.js:8-11, 34-42).

The five commitment marks top out at 30 days (constants.js:218-225), and their thresholds (1/3/7/14/30) do not match the proposed ember/flame/heart stages (7/30/100). Five little marks next to the number can also be read as five credits.
Recovery card copy is ungrammatical: «1 تمارين ثم يوم راحة · أنجزت 0» (HomePage.jsx:342; state-recovery-open.png).
gaps: Best streak in 🔥 units (eligible days) is neither computed nor stored. The Profile label is false, and the report's all-time run is in session units. The ledger only carries running totals for the current run (rows outside it have streak=null, recovery.js:309-313).

No history of past runs (start, end, length, reason ended). Only the latest brokenBy exists, and nothing records what number was displayed over time, which is why the 30→6 drop could not be self-diagnosed.

No explicit per-today fields: todayCounted, todayKind (pending/eligible/paid), 'a miss today would spend a credit vs break', or 'frozen for N days in a row'. All are derivable from the last ledger rows but not exposed.
A true usable credit balance, or a real cap: restCredits (clamped) disagrees with what the engine will actually absorb.
No forward projection. The engine stops at today, so there is no 'tomorrow is rest/workout' and no 'next scheduled rest in N days' beyond cycleLimit − workoutStreak.
No countdown to the 03:00 deadline in the UI, though nextDayTurn() exists (day.js:50-55).
Next milestone and days to it are not shown, though STREAK_MILESTONES exists (utils.js:630).
No on-Home per-day 'why it counted' strip (trained / plan rest / paid / miss / pending). The data is in the ledger, but it is only rendered in the Settings diagnostics table.
No proactive streak-at-risk notification before 03:00. Notifications are generic, timer-based, and only fire while the app is open (utils.js:502-540).
No user control over credits: no way to choose a rest day or keep credits. REST_TAKEN and the restTaken greeting pool are effectively unreachable.
No dated log of credits earned and spent beyond the last 7 days on Home. Earn dates exist only as ledger rows.
Nothing tells the lifter that deload weeks do not protect attendance.
changeCooldownLeft (days until a plan/frequency change is free) is shown only in Settings, not near the streak.

surfaces.shows: An orange pill reading «🔥 60» (or «🔥 10») next to the timer and settings buttons. It has no unit and no label. It is a plain <div> with no onClick, and it is hidden when the streak is 0. It has no white-space:nowrap, so at phone width it wraps and the flame sits on top of the number (page-home.png, header left).
surfaces.evidence: page-home.png: 60. state-credit-spent.png: 10, safe, one credit left. state-credit-warning.png: 10, zero credits and at risk, and the pill looks identical. Probe of the veteran fixture with computeRecovery: last workout 10 days ago, 8 days auto-paid (2026-06-30 to 07-07), and the pill still shows 60.
surfaces.clarity: How long: yes. It is the only answer on every tab, but it is a bare number with no «يوم». Is it safe today: no. The safe, at-risk and frozen-for-8-days states look exactly the same. What to do and by when: no. Credits: no. Why: no. Tapping does nothing, and when the streak breaks the pill just disappears, so a drop like 30 to 0 (or 30 to 6) gets no explanation.

When credits are freezing a 60-day streak, it talks about «الغياب» next to a full, healthy 60, and the two contradict each other. It also uses 🔥 as decoration in lines that have nothing to do with the streak.

problems: Three different numbers are each called the streak. (1) Home 🔥, the greeting, achievements and «أيام التزام» use consistencyStreak, which counts training days plus scheduled rests (App.jsx:535; recovery.js:200-201, 296-306). (2) «تمارين متتالية» is workoutStreak, which resets on every rest day (recovery.js:182). (3) The report and poster «أطول سلسلة» count training days only (monthReport.js:163-181; Consistency.jsx:73; reportPoster.js:190). For the same March history the three read 31, 1 and 16. monthReport.js:153-157 claims (3) equals the home flame, which is false. This is the same failure as the 30-to-6 incident: one name, two counts.

The number never shows its state. 🔥 60 looks the same when safe, when frozen by credits and when at risk (state-credit-spent vs state-credit-warning). It has no unit and no label. In the veteran fixture the man has not trained for 10 days, 8 credits were auto-spent, and the pill still shows a healthy 60 with full flames.

The 'is it safe today' warning is placed too low. The only Home signal is the summary row of a collapsed <details>, which comes after the hero, deload suggestion, strip, month-report strip and plan card (HomePage.jsx:182-304). With a plan active it is below the fold (page-home-full.png). The hero, where he decides to train or skip, says nothing, and at zero credits the 🎟️ chip simply disappears (TodayHero.jsx:199). Absence is the only cue.

No deadline appears anywhere. The day turns at 03:00 (day.js:20; App.jsx:544-548), but no UI string mentions 03:00 or الفجر (grep finds it only in comments). The warning says «اليوم», which is ambiguous at 00:30. Notifications know nothing about the streak.

«تخطي اليوم» (App.jsx:382-385) only advances the plan. At 03:00 the day is judged a miss, so a credit is auto-spent or the streak ends, and the button and its alert «تم تخطي يوم التمرين» say nothing about this. There is also no deliberate 'use a credit today' action: REST_TAKEN can't be reached from the UI, and restDays is written only by auto-spend (App.jsx:505-530). That contradicts the brief's idea of credits he can spend.

Spent credits are under-reported. The notice names only the last paid day (HomePage.jsx:145-147, 294, 384) and disappears after 7 days. The toast lasts about 3.2s, covers the 🔥 pill, and collapses several days into a count with no dates (App.jsx:520-523). Days before autoSpendFrom are never announced. In the veteran case, 8 paid days show up as one date.

The credit cap of 5 is display-only. restCredits = min(5, earned − spent) (recovery.js:312, 318), but auto-spend checks the uncapped earned − spent ≥ 1 (recovery.js:239). Probe: after a 60-day run, 6 missed days are all paid and the balance still reads 5. The ledger shows «−1» with the balance unchanged, and the report tip «رصيدك ممتلئ ولا يزيد أكثر… بدل أن يضيع» (monthReport.js:640) is false. 'Why is the number what it is' fails even inside the audit tool.

A broken streak is silent. brokenBy is computed (recovery.js:330) but never rendered. The pill and strip hide at 0 (App.jsx:805; HomePage.jsx:218). No message says 'it broke on X after N days' or what the record was.
«أفضل streak» on Profile is the current streak (ProfilePage.jsx:72, 431). The only real all-time best is inside the month report, and it uses the training-days definition.

The same number is repeated while the meaning appears once. Home shows 60 in the header pill, again in the strip, as «أيام التزام», in «(60 يوم)», and sometimes in the greeting, up to five times. The safety status appears once, low and collapsed. Profile repeats the tiles again.

The greeting contradicts the streak. The comeback pool outranks the streak pool (utils.js:637 vs 642-643), so a credit-frozen 60 is greeted with «الغياب انتهى» or «رجعتك أهم من غيابك» (page-home, page-home-full, page-profile, page-achievements). Lines come from a shuffle bag, so the greeting can't be relied on for information.

The deload rule is unstated and contradicts the owner's belief. deload.js:4 says the streak is not protected and computeRecovery ignores deload, yet the UI swaps flames for calm droplets and greets «لا تستعجله», which implies leniency (state-home-deload.png).

Names are inconsistent. The streak is called ستريك / سلسلة / أيام التزام / الالتزام / streak / الـstreak / أيام متواصلة. Credits are called رصيد راحة / أيام راحة اختيارية / يوم راحة اختياري / أرصدة / مكافأة / شريط الراحة الاختيارية / يوم الراحة المدفوع, and «راحة اختيارية» also names a day type in the report. The word تذكرة/تذاكر never appears even though 🎟️ is the icon. The protected state is «سليم» on Home, «مجمّد لا مكسور» in the toast and «محفوظ» in Settings.

Colours are inconsistent. The streak appears in orange (header, strip, أفضل streak), gold (أيام التزام, report all-time; HomePage.jsx:447-450, ProfilePage.jsx:417, Consistency.jsx:49), green (report month row and ring; flames at 30+) and blue #3B9DE8 (poster tile; flames at 14-29). Credits are gold (HomePage.jsx:351-424; TodayHero.jsx:204; Consistency.jsx:249), but Floodlight reserves gold for raise-weight and blue for rest. Report scheduled rests use the same #3B9DE8 as the poster streak. Misnamed tokens (--cyan = #5EC32A green, --purple = #3B9DE8 blue; index.css:31, 53) hide all this in code.

The flame is not reserved for the streak. 🔥 also appears in general greetings (constants.js:24, 27, 49, 61, 92), the «حرق الدهون» goal (230), the «30 سيت في جلسة» achievement (760), notifications (1010, 1033) and Photos «يوم من الرحلة 🔥» (PhotosPage.jsx:80). The fresh screen shows 🔥 with no streak.

The five-mark meter is ambiguous and stops at 30. Its tiers are 1/3/7/14/30 (constants.js:218-225), but it looks like a 5-step progress bar, the same shape as the 0/5 credit bar, and it is full from 30 on. There are four different milestone ladders: flames 1/3/7/14/30, achievements 3/7/14/30/60/100, greetings 7/10/14/21/30/40/50/60… (utils.js:630), and the Floodlight proposal 7/30/100.

The 'why' screen is buried and written for developers: Settings › إدارة البيانات, labelled «(تشخيص)», titled after the credit bar, with columns «في restDays» and «الـstreak», totals like «consistencyStreak = 60», ISO dates, and only the last 20 days (RestLedgerPanel.jsx:24, 53-56; restLedger.js:8-11, 34-42). You cannot trace a 60-day streak to its start, and the 🔥 pill is not tappable to get there.

Copy and format bugs: «1 تمارين ثم يوم راحة · أنجزت 0» (HomePage.jsx:342; also ProfilePage.jsx:420 and SettingsPage.jsx:506 «1 تمارين ← راحة»); mixed digits «٠ من 3» (state-home-fresh); Hijri dates with Arabic-Indic digits from fmtDate 'ar-SA' (utils.js:97) vs Gregorian «25 أغسطس» in the report vs ISO dates in the ledger; the header pill wraps so 🔥 stacks over 60 (App.jsx:806-812 has no nowrap); and the unlabelled «5×» chip sits next to the 🎟️ count in the hero.

Missing captures: the manifest asks state-credit-spent and state-credit-warning to open the details and scroll to the card (scripts/screens.manifest.mjs:409-422), but both PNGs show only the collapsed row. The in-card red warning box has never been captured. The dated paid notice appears only in state-recovery-open.

What this means for Floodlight: the earlier plan (no header pill, streak in a «هذا الأسبوع» chapter below the Today stage) repeats today's main failure, where the streak status sits below the decision. Today's status (safe, at risk, frozen, broken), the deadline and the credit count belong in the Today stage or directly attached to it, under one definition and one name. Orange is for the streak number only and blue is for credits.
keep: The engine: a forward walk that spends a credit at the moment it is needed; derived values, never stored; the same history always replays to the same ledger (recovery.js:205-248, 257-267; tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs). Fix the cap so it is real, but keep the model.
A paid day freezes the streak (no increase, no break), and the sentence that explains it: «يُصرف تلقائياً لو غبت، فيجمّد ستريكك بلا زيادة ولا كسر» (HomePage.jsx:369).

The red warning's content and its threshold. It fires only on a training day with 0 credits and a streak of 5 or more, and it includes the streak number: «لا رصيد راحة — اليوم يوم تمرين، وإن غبت عنه ينكسر ستريكك (N يوم)» (HomePage.jsx:148-153, 292, 399-400). Move it up and add the 03:00 deadline.

The principle of naming the paid day with its date, and the toast «ستريكك مجمّد لا مكسور» (HomePage.jsx:137-144, 384-388; App.jsx:500-523). Extend it to every paid day, add the balance left, and make it persist.
The rest-day hero line «لن يُحتسب غياباً ولن يكسر الستريك.» (TodayHero.jsx:225). This is how today's status should read on every kind of day.

Settings states the streak cost, with the number, before a frequency or plan change, and the button «غيّر واكسر الستريك» names the consequence (SettingsPage.jsx:502-510, 636-659). Pattern history means a change never rewrites past days (recovery.js:31-35, 78-90).
The 03:00 day boundary, including late sessions counting for the evening before (day.js:5-20; tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:467-482). Keep it, but make it visible.

The day-by-day audit ledger, the history-restore report and copy-as-text (RestLedgerPanel.jsx:74-93, 152-163; restLedger.js). Keep the capability, but give it plain-Arabic labels, full-run coverage and a way in from the streak itself.
The achievement descriptions «تمريناً أو راحة» (constants.js:795-821), which are the right one-line definition of the streak.
Credit progress kept separate from the streak, with its footnote (HomePage.jsx:345-349, 403-429; tests 'progress and streak are genuinely different numbers').

The structure of the report's streak block: this month / last month / all time, the «مستمرة» flag, the carried-over note and «🏆 رقمك القياسي» (Consistency.jsx:37-122). Keep the structure, fix the definition.

The state-aware greeting pools that never tell a resting man to train, the creditSpent voice («رصيدك غطّاك أمس… اليوم أنت تغطّي نفسك»), and a milestone line said once, on the day (constants.js:94-203). Fix the comeback-over-streak priority.

Streak numbers in Western digits via toWesternDigits, which suits Archivo tabular figures, and orange #F97316 (--orange) already used for the header and strip number, which matches Floodlight's --streak.

apps.app: Duolingo: flame in the top bar, streak drawer, freeze and repair
apps.pattern: WHERE: the flame and count sit in the home top bar. Duolingo's 2017 post says streaks 'appear prominently on the home screen with a flame icon in the top bar'. Tapping the flame ('tap on the streak flame at the top of your home page') opens a streak drawer with PERSONAL and FRIENDS tabs, Friend Streak counts, an invite slot and nudge buttons. NUMBER: a plain day count next to the flame. Early days get louder feedback because 2 to 3 days is +50% but 200 to 201 is only +0.5%. WHAT COUNTS: one lesson a day. In 2020 Duolingo split the streak from the XP goal: D14 retention +3.3%, learners on a streak +10.5%, 7+ day streaks up more than 40%. PROTECTION: a Streak Freeze 'allows you to hit pause on your streak for a day'. You can equip up to 2, which beat 1 by +0.38% daily active learners. The at-risk upsell says 'Protect your 3 day streak!', shows 'You have 0 of 2 equipped' as two empty flame outlines, and offers a refill. Freezes only work if held before the missed day. Third-party guides say a frozen day keeps the count without adding to it and shows as a blue frozen flame on the calendar, and that a week with no freezes turns the flame yellow (Perfect Streak). Users report that calendar colours for freeze and miss are ambiguous. REPAIR: a Streak Repair can be bought with gems after a break. EXPERIMENTS: 600+ streak tests. 'commit to my goal' beat 'continue'. Letting users choose a streak goal raised their sense of ownership. The Weekend Amulet made users 4% more likely to return and 5% less likely to lose the streak.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) Put the streak in the persistent top chrome and make the flame itself the button that opens the explanation. In Meran the header pill is a plain div with no onClick (src/App.jsx:805-813) and the Home strip number is 12px (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:218-221), so a tap explains nothing. (2) Show protection as an inventory: tickets as N of 5 slots like 'You have 0 of 2 equipped', in --rest blue. (3) Meran's paid rest day already behaves like a freeze: it holds the streak and adds nothing (src/recovery.js:192-196, 296-306). Say exactly that in one line ('التذكرة تحمي ستريكك وما تزيده'). AVOID: calendar shades that Duolingo users found ambiguous. Give scheduled rest (+1) and ticket days (+0) different glyphs, not just two shades. Also avoid the gem-shop guilt. Meran's tickets are earned, every 5 eligible days (src/recovery.js:59-60), and that is the better story.

apps.app: Duolingo: widget, lock screen and the at-risk evening
apps.pattern: The home-screen widget shows only two facts: the current streak length and whether today's lesson is done. Duolingo says 'simply reminding a learner of their current streak, and whether or not it's at risk' is hugely valuable and that extra stats were not needed. Duo's illustration gets more desperate as the day runs out ('he gets more and more desperate as it nears midnight!') and relaxes once the lesson is done. A lock-screen widget shows e.g. '200 day streak'. Half of the learners with the widget have a streak of at least 6 months, and their retention stays far better even after correcting for self-selection. The tips post suggests an 11:50pm alarm ('Did you do your lesson?') and says notifications are timed 'at the perfect time'.
apps.lesson: TAKE: Meran's at-a-glance state should be exactly two facts: the number, and whether today has extended it. Escalate as the training day nears its real end, which is 03:00 not midnight (DAY_START_HOUR = 3, src/day.js:20, nextDayTurn src/day.js:50-55). Example: 'باقي ٣ ساعات — الجيم يقفل ٣'. Meran's notifications cannot do this today. They are state-blind fixed slots at 08:00, 12:30, 15:30, workout hour and 21:00 (src/utils.js:512-518). The 21:00 one asks 'هل أكملت تمرينك اليوم؟' whether or not he trained (src/constants.js:1040-1048). They also use setTimeout, so they only fire while the app is open (src/utils.js:521-537). AVOID: Duo-style guilt. Escalate the information (time left, ticket cost) instead of the emotion.

apps.app: Duolingo: milestones, share card, and repairing streaks after outages
apps.pattern: MILESTONES: on milestone days (examples given: 1 week, 1 month, 100 days, 1 year and beyond) Duo turns into a flaming phoenix on the post-lesson streak screen. The earlier balloons-at-50/100/365 version was replaced because it 'lacked energy'. Research found that some new learners did not understand the streak and that the fire metaphor 'is not shared by all cultures'. The team kept fire but carried it on a culturally universal figure. A share card ('I just reached a streak!') saves or posts in one tap. The milestone animation raised the chance a new learner was still active 7 days later by +1.7%, and 2025 brought new milestone animations. TRUST: the 'Big Red Button' pauses the app during outages, tells learners why, and afterwards repairs interrupted streaks with freeze logic (over 2 million streaks protected) because a lost streak makes learners 'feel cheated'. On 13 Sep 2025 the status page posted 'some learners' streaks appear reset or display incorrectly... working to restore affected streaks', then deployed a fix and resolved it the same day.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) Celebrate the milestone on the post-workout screen of the session that crosses it, with one beat of motion, a 96px numeral and a poster/share card. Today STREAK_MILESTONES (src/utils.js:630) only switches the greeting pool (src/utils.js:642). (2) Keep one glyph. Grow the flame (ember to flame to full flame) rather than switching to hearts at 30, which would be the comprehension problem Duolingo found. Never recolour it green or blue: in Floodlight green means action and blue means rest. Today the commitment marks cycle through orange, yellow, green, blue and green (src/constants.js:218-225), and page-home.png shows five green marks beside an orange 60. (3) Lesson from the 30-to-6 drop: when the number changes for any reason other than a day passing (migration, history restore, settings change), say so once, with before, after and the reason. src/App.jsx:71-99 rebuilt history and only wrote a report to Settings. The frequency-change toasts already do this well: 'ستريكك محفوظ' and 'بدأ ستريك جديد' (src/App.jsx:730-731).

apps.pattern: The streak is drawn on the Activity Path chart rather than shown as a counter: 'whenever you are within your recommended activity levels, the dots connect, creating a gentler streak! When you fall/fly outside of it, the streak breaks' (v2.7.3). Rest is a valid answer: 'Keep your streak alive by following your body's needs, even when it calls for rest days', and daily suggestions range from rest to high intensity based on readiness. The home site says 'taking a break never means starting over'. Activity Status (break, sick, injured) adjusts the streak so you can 'skip feeling guilty'. Reviewers note this is Premium. A 2025 For You tab merges the streak with health info. Release 5.12.x added a 'What's Activity Path' button directly on the daily, 10-day and 30-day view picker, an explainer right next to the visual. A Morning Check-In notification follows up the morning after a day you chose to rest. Views: daily readiness, 10-day, 30-day, plus weekly, monthly and yearly recaps.
apps.lesson: TAKE: this is Meran's closest model, because Meran also counts scheduled rest as keeping the plan (eligible days, src/recovery.js:189-202). (1) Show rest as part of the chain in the week strip, connected rather than a gap: the run continues through a scheduled rest day. (2) Put a '؟ كيف ينحسب' explainer right beside the streak visual, not in Settings. Meran's only per-day audit is 'سجل المكافأة (تشخيص)' under Settings, Data management (panel-rest-ledger.png, src/components/RestLedgerPanel.jsx), and its columns mix in English internals ('الـstreak', 'في restDays', src/restLedger.js:8-11). (3) Name the state when the plan says rest, e.g. 'راحة مجدولة — ستريكك يزيد تلقائياً'. AVOID: hiding the number entirely. Gentler can afford that, but the owner explicitly wants the number to be clear.

apps.app: Apple Fitness / Activity (rings, award streaks, Pause Rings)
apps.pattern: At a glance, the rings are today's state, always visible in the Activity app, on watch faces and in widgets. Streaks are not a header number. They live in Awards: Longest Move Streak, and Perfect Week, which requires every day Monday to Sunday. watchOS 11 / iOS 18 added Pause Rings: 'you can pause your Activity rings for up to 90 days without breaking your award streak, and resume at any time'. Presets include Today, Until Monday, Until next month, or a custom date. While paused 'the streak isn't lost, but the numbers won't increase', and counting resumes afterwards. Goals can also be scheduled per weekday (a lighter target on lighter days), and each Monday a summary suggests goals. Activity notifications include Daily Coaching nudges as you near a goal, Goal Completions and Special Challenges. Users complain that pause applies to all rings at once.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) Always show a today-progress mark next to the streak number, like a ring. For Meran it is binary: an unlit flame before training, lit after. The number alone does not say whether today is done, because a pending training day is excluded until trained (src/recovery.js:237-238, 291, 296). (2) Copy Apple's wording for protected days: 'محفوظ، ما يزيد'. That is exactly Meran's paid-day rule. (3) Deload is Meran's goal-schedule equivalent: the bar is lighter but the streak counts normally. So do not swap the metaphor. Under deload the Home marks become cyan droplets (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:98-107, state-home-deload.png) while the header still shows 🔥60. Keep the flame and add a small 'ديلود' tag.

apps.pattern: Placement: a fire emoji plus the number sit inline next to each friend in the Chat list. 'The number next to the fire emoji shows how many days old your Streak is.' At-risk: 'If you see an hourglass emoji next to the Chat, your Streak is about to expire!' The hourglass is a separate glyph appended only near expiry; the friend-emoji guide labels it 'Streak is ending'. Rules are explicit about what counts: photo or video Snaps both ways every day, and Chat messages do not count. Recovery: a lost streak can be restored 'for a limited time only', and a fire-emoji button shows when it can be. There is one free restore, then paid ones (about $1 in the US), with extra restores for Snapchat+. The restore window is reported as 24 to 48 hours.
apps.lesson: TAKE: a dedicated at-risk glyph (Phosphor Hourglass in --streak) attached to the number, shown ONLY in the true danger window: a training day, not yet trained, no ticket left, and late in the training day. Meran's atRisk today is less precise. It shows all day from 03:00, only when the streak is 5 or more (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:152-153). As written it also does not exclude a day already trained or already paid with a ticket: isRecoveryDay is the only status check, so COMPLETED or REST_TAKEN with an empty balance would still read 'إن لم تتمرّن اليوم ينكسر ستريكك' (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:130, 152, 292). This is plausible from the code but untested: tests/deload.e2e.mjs:552-578 covers only the untrained case. AVOID: monetised restore. When a ticket balance exists, at-risk means 'a ticket will be spent', not 'it breaks', so state the cost.

apps.pattern: Weekly unit: at least one activity of 60 seconds or more per Monday-to-Sunday week. Every sport counts, including manual uploads, and so do all privacy settings. It lives in Progress under the You tab, for free and paid users. An activity started in the evening and finished the next day counts for the day it started. Celebration banners appear for activities in weeks 2 to 5 and at 10, 15 and 25 weeks and 1, 2 and 3 years, and currently cannot be turned off. Restore: uploading or syncing a missed activity after the week updates the streak automatically. Deleting the only activity of a week ends it, and restoring the activity brings it back.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) Write the boundary rule down in one line, the way Strava does. Meran's equivalent: 'اليوم التدريبي يبدأ ٣ الفجر — جلسة ١ الليل تنحسب لليوم اللي قبله' (src/day.js:5-12). Put it in the streak sheet, since the 03:00 turn is invisible today. (2) Back-dating repairs: Meran already replays from history, so a forgotten session added later fixes the streak by itself (src/recovery.js:265-267). Say so in the sheet: 'نسيت تسجّل؟ أضف الجلسة بتاريخها ويرجع الستريك'. (3) Celebrate dense early milestones and sparse later ones. Meran's set (src/utils.js:630) has that shape already.

apps.pattern: The streak sits at the top of the Calendar (Profile, Calendar): the active streak on the left counts consecutive weeks with at least one session, and a rest-day counter beside it shows how many rest days since the last workout. Workout days are highlighted blue and all other days count as rest. On the first session of a new week Hevy shows the ordinal number of your streak. A missed week can be recovered by logging a past workout dated inside it, even a walk, and it is 'added to your previous streak to extend it'. Year and multi-year calendar views and widgets exist. Some users pass 100 weeks.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) The number lives with the calendar that proves it. The streak sheet should open on the week strip and month grid with each day's kind. (2) Reveal the streak number at the moment of action: the finish screen should say 'ستريكك صار ٦١'. (3) A pair of numbers works when the second is clearly a different thing: Hevy's 'rest days since last workout' next to the streak. Meran's pair is confusing instead: 'تمارين متتالية' (workoutStreak, which resets every rest day) sits next to 'أيام التزام' (the real streak) in two colours (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:433-456, src/pages/ProfilePage.jsx:416-417). Rename workoutStreak to cycle progress, e.g. '٢ من ٣ قبل الراحة', so only one number is ever called streak.

apps.pattern: I could not confirm any streak feature in Strong. Its site and store listings centre on logging, history, best sets and 1RM, and the only widgets I found were for measurements. Peer lifting apps fill the gap with weekly-goal streaks: Fitbod counts consecutive weeks meeting a weekly workout goal, TrainHeroic counts consecutive weeks with at least one session, and Tonal warns near the end of the week if no workout has been logged.
apps.lesson: TAKE: a gym log can earn trust by being plain. Every number traces back to sessions. Meran's engine is built this way: derived, never stored, the same history always gives the same ledger (src/recovery.js:265-267). The Floodlight UI should expose that audit trail in human terms. AVOID: a streak whose definition changes between screens. Meran's month report and poster count only training days ('أطول سلسلة', src/monthReport.js:153-157, 178; sheet-save-poster.png shows 16 = 16 sessions), while the header flame counts eligible days including scheduled rest (src/App.jsx:535; src/recovery.js:200-202, 302). The report even claims to count 'the same thing the flame on the home screen counts' (src/components/report/sections/Consistency.jsx:66-68) and says rest 'لا يُحسب منها' (line 73), which contradicts Home.

apps.pattern: The streak counts consecutive days of collecting WHOOP data. Per a staff reply in Aug 2025 it 'tracks how many consecutive days a member collects WHOOP data'. Since about Sept 2025 a small flame with the number sits next to the member's profile picture on Home. Users' threads ask what the flame means ('Day Streak Meaning', 'flame icon with days'), which shows the glyph appeared without an explanation surface. The Performance Profile also lists data streaks such as consecutive green recoveries and consecutive days at 70% or more of sleep need. A streak lost to a sync glitch cannot be restored in public; members must email Membership Services for an account review (thread dated Sep 2026).
apps.lesson: TAKE: placement next to identity (avatar or name) makes the streak feel personal and permanent. AVOID: a bare flame with no explanation, which produced 'what does this mean' threads. Also avoid 'contact support' as the way to understand a changed number. That is Meran's 30-to-6 story. The fix is self-serve: tap the flame and see the start date, the day that would have broken it, and which days tickets covered. The engine already provides streakStart, brokenBy, restTakenHistory and missedDays (src/recovery.js:320-360).

apps.pattern: The run streak lives on the Profile. The help centre spells out what counts and what does not: sleepcasts, sleep and focus music, Wake Up, mindful activity and movement sessions do not count. It lists reasons a streak may reset: more than a day since the last meditation, extended airplane mode, or a technical problem. Users can turn the run streak off from Profile. Built For Mars (Oct 2024) highlighted 'Hiding your Headspace streaks', tagged under loss aversion and anxiety.
apps.lesson: TAKE: publish 'what counts / what doesn't / why it might reset' as three short lines in the streak sheet, including Meran's real reset causes. Those are a missed training day with no ticket, and a settings change made over the free quota, which deliberately restarts it via streakResetAt (src/recovery.js:37, 232-235; src/App.jsx:703-744). AVOID: hiding. The owner wants visibility, so offer calm and precise copy instead of an off switch.

apps.pattern: The streak sits in Profile, then Dashboard, alongside session history, a calendar of meditated days and the current streak. The help centre lists what counts (meditations, Sleep Stories, Breathe Bubbles, The Spark, Calm Body, Masterclasses) and what does not (music, soundscapes, Check-Ins). Repair is self-serve: add a missed session for any past date and 'your streak count will automatically recalculate'. Travel and time zones are named as a cause of odd numbers. Mindful Reminders are opt-in under Settings.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) Streak plus calendar plus history on one surface is the explanation. (2) Self-serve repair plus automatic recalculation builds trust, and Meran can make the same promise because its numbers are replayed. (3) Name the clock edge cases. For Meran that is the 03:00 turn: a 01:00 session belongs to the previous training day (src/day.js:5-12). Also pick one calendar for streak dates. Notices use fmtDate in ar-SA, which renders Hijri ('السبت، ٢٦ محرم' in state-credit-spent.png; tests/deload.e2e.mjs:532), while the month report uses Gregorian months (src/components/report/sections/Consistency.jsx:26-27).

apps.pattern: Weekly streaks need one run per week. Streaks came to the Apple Watch app in 2020 with a Weekly Streaks complication for at-a-glance motivation. Each week you keep the streak alive unlocks the next streak icon for the watch face, so longer streaks unlock more exclusive icons. Streaks are separate from distance Challenges and Achievements. I found no current help page on missed-week rules.
apps.lesson: TAKE: (1) A glanceable surface outside the app matters. For a PWA the realistic equivalents are the app icon badge (Badging API where supported) and a state-aware notification, not a widget. (2) Milestone glyph tiers can be collectible, but should stay in one family: flame sizes and intensities, not new icons or colours. AVOID: tiers that require learning a legend. Meran's 0-5 commitment marks with level names (src/constants.js:218-225) are a second, unexplained scale next to the number.

principles: ONE STREAK, ONE NUMBER, ONE NAME, ONE COLOUR. Meran currently shows several different numbers as streak-like. (a) consistencyStreak, the header flame and Home strip (src/App.jsx:535). (b) workoutStreak, labelled 'تمارين متتالية' (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:439-442; src/pages/ProfilePage.jsx:416). (c) The month-report and poster 'أطول سلسلة', which counts only sessions (src/monthReport.js:153-178; sheet-save-poster.png). (d) 'أفضل streak', which is really the current streak (bestStreak = streak, src/pages/ProfilePage.jsx:72, 431). Pick one definition: eligible days, meaning trained days plus scheduled rest. Call it 'الستريك' everywhere and render it only in --streak #F97316 with Archivo tabular numerals. Rename (b) to cycle progress, e.g. '٢ من ٣ قبل الراحة'. Make (c) and the poster use the same unit, or label them 'جلسات'. Compute a true best streak from the ledger. Fix the report copy that says rest neither breaks nor counts (src/components/report/sections/Consistency.jsx:73). On Home a scheduled rest adds +1 (src/recovery.js:200-202, 302).

AT A GLANCE = TWO FACTS, as in the Duolingo widget: the number, and today's state. Use a closed set of states drawn from the engine. Training day, not yet trained: unlit flame outline, number excludes today (src/recovery.js:237-238, 291). Trained: lit flame, number +1. Scheduled rest: lit flame with a --rest moon, +1 automatically. Ticket day (REST_TAKEN or auto-paid): flame with a --rest ticket, held at +0. At risk: hourglass. Deload: same flame plus a small 'ديلود' tag. Never let a state change the glyph family or colour. Today deload swaps the flames for cyan droplets (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:98-107).

VISIBLE ON EVERY SCREEN, TAPPABLE EVERYWHERE. Duolingo (top bar), WHOOP (next to the avatar) and Snapchat (inline per chat) all keep the streak in persistent chrome, and in each the glyph itself opens the explanation. Because the owner says 'it must be clear', restore a compact streak chip in the Floodlight global header rather than burying it in a below-the-fold 'هذا الأسبوع' chapter. Make it a real button: today it is a div (src/App.jsx:805-813). Keep the week chapter as the strip inside the streak sheet and on Home.

SAY WHAT TODAY DOES TO THE NUMBER, INSIDE THE TODAY STAGE. One line under the action, for example: 'تمرين اليوم يخلّي ستريكك ٦١' / 'راحة مجدولة — ستريكك ٦١ تلقائياً' / 'تذكرة راحة — ستريكك يبقى ٦٠' / 'إن غبت اليوم تُصرف تذكرة (يبقى ٣)'. This copies Duolingo's lesson-end extension and Hevy's ordinal-on-first-session, and links the one green action to the streak without a second lit element.

ONE TAP → ONE STREAK SHEET THAT ANSWERS 'WHY THIS NUMBER'. Contents: the big numeral (56px); 'بدأت <date>' (streakStart); a 7-day strip and month grid with distinct glyphs for trained (+1), scheduled rest (+1), ticket (held, +0), deload rim, pending today and the break day; the true best streak; the ticket balance as N of 5 slots plus 'باقي X أيام لتذكرة' (creditProgress, daysToNextCredit); the next milestone; and three rule lines covering what counts, what protects it, and the 03:00 day turn. Add a 'سجل يوم بيوم' link to the existing ledger, rewritten without internal English column names ('الـstreak', 'في restDays', src/restLedger.js:8-11) and moved out of Settings diagnostics (panel-rest-ledger.png).

PROTECTION IS ITS OWN STATE, AND IT IS 'HELD', NOT 'EARNED'. Apple: 'the streak isn't lost, but the numbers won't increase'. Duolingo: a freeze 'pauses' a day. Meran's paid rest is exactly this (src/recovery.js:192-196, 296-306), and the copy 'مجمّد لا مكسور' (src/App.jsx:522) is good. Keep it. Colour tickets and rest in --rest #3B9DE8, not gold. Gold today marks tickets and paid days (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:351-425; src/components/report/sections/Consistency.jsx:13), which collides with Floodlight's rule that gold means 'raise the weight' only.

AUTO-SPENDS ARE ANNOUNCED WITH A DATE, ONCE, AND STAY ON THE CALENDAR. Meran already does the right thing: a toast with the date (src/App.jsx:516-524) and a dated notice for 7 days (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:145-147, 378-389). In Floodlight, keep the toast and add the ticket glyph on that day in the sheet, so a held day can always be found later. Don't rely on a 7-day banner.

AT-RISK IS RARE, TIME-AWARE AND HONEST ABOUT THE COST. Snapchat shows the hourglass only near expiry, and Duo panics toward midnight. Meran's day ends at 03:00 (src/day.js:20, 50-55), so the risk window and its countdown should be keyed to 03:00 ('باقي ٣ ساعات — الجيم يقفل ٣'). Show the hourglass only on an untrained training day. With tickets left, say 'تُصرف تذكرة'. Only with zero tickets say 'ينكسر'. Fix the current condition so a trained (COMPLETED) or ticketed (REST_TAKEN) day can never show 'إن لم تتمرّن اليوم ينكسر ستريكك'. As written it only excludes RECOVERY (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:130, 152-153, 292), and no test covers that case (tests/deload.e2e.mjs:552-578).

THE NUMBER NEVER CHANGES SILENTLY. Duolingo repairs outage-broken streaks and posts a status notice ('streaks appear reset... working to restore'). WHOOP users had to email support. For Meran, store the last-seen streak, and whenever a recompute moves it other than by one day passing (a migration such as src/App.jsx:71-99, a settings change, an import), show a one-time explanation: 'ستريكك تغيّر من ٣٠ إلى ٦ — السبب: ... — شوف الأيام'. The frequency and plan change toasts already set this tone (src/App.jsx:730-744).

REST IS PART OF THE CHAIN, VISUALLY. As in Gentler Streak, where the dots connect through rest: in the week strip a scheduled rest day connects the run (+1), a ticket day connects it without adding, and only a miss with no ticket cuts the line. Make the definition one sentence: 'الستريك = أيام التزامك بالخطة: تمرين أو راحة مجدولة. التذكرة تحميه وما تزيده.'

COPY MUST AGREE WITH THE NUMBER. The greeting picks the 'comeback' pool after 5 or more days without training, before checking the streak (src/utils.js:636-644). That is why the screenshots show 'المهم إنك رجعت' and 'اليوم الأول بعد الغياب' next to 🔥60 (state-recovery-open.png, page-profile.png, page-achievements.png). If tickets or scheduled rest kept the streak alive, say so ('ستريكك صمد ٥ أيام بالتذاكر — يلا نكمّل'). Also fix plural grammar such as '1 تمارين ثم يوم راحة' (src/pages/HomePage.jsx:342; state-recovery-open.png).

MILESTONES: ONE LIT MOMENT, ON THE DAY, AFTER THE ACTION. Celebrate on the finish screen of the session that crosses a milestone (Duolingo phoenix, Strava banners, Hevy ordinal), with one beat of motion then rest, a 96px poster numeral and a share or save card. Show 'المحطة الجاية: ٧٠ (باقي ٩)' in the sheet. Keep the glyph a flame that grows in size and heat. Do not switch to hearts or to green and blue tiers. Duolingo found that even fire needed help to be understood, and green and blue already mean action and rest in Floodlight. STREAK_MILESTONES exists (src/utils.js:630) but only feeds the greeting (src/utils.js:642).

ONE SCALE, NOT TWO. Drop or fold the 0-5 commitment marks and their level names (src/constants.js:218-225; src/pages/HomePage.jsx:103-122). In page-home.png they sit as a second, colour-shifting meter beside the number and need a legend nobody sees. Express tier through the single flame's size instead.

STATE-AWARE NOTIFICATIONS, FEW AND REAL. Replace the fixed, state-blind slots (src/utils.js:512-518; evening copy src/constants.js:1040-1048) with at most one streak reminder per training day. It fires only if the day is untrained and the streak would break or spend a ticket, it is timed against 03:00, and it names the number and cost ('ستريكك ٦٠ — باقي ٣ ساعات، وما عندك تذكرة'). Use real Web Push for the installed PWA. The setTimeout scheduler only fires while the app is open (src/utils.js:521-537). Send a morning-after line when a ticket was auto-spent, as Gentler Streak's Morning Check-In does after a rest day.

WRITE THE CLOCK AND THE REPAIR PATH DOWN. Strava, Calm and Hevy all publish their boundary and back-fill rules. Meran's sheet should say 'اليوم التدريبي يبدأ ٣ الفجر' (src/day.js:5-12) and 'نسيت تسجّل؟ أضف الجلسة بتاريخها ويرجع الستريك', which is true because the ledger is replayed from history (src/recovery.js:265-267). Use one calendar (Gregorian or Hijri) for every streak date. Notices are Hijri today and the report is Gregorian (tests/deload.e2e.mjs:532; src/components/report/sections/Consistency.jsx:26-27).

designs.name: «لوحة الستريك» (The Scoreboard): the Floodlight streak system with the streak as the Home hero
designs.thesis: There is one streak, with one number, one name («الستريك») and one colour (#F97316). On Home it is the scoreboard at the top: a 96pt broadcast numeral that never appears without a line saying what today does to it and by when (03:00). Tapping it anywhere opens «ليش 60؟». That sheet shows the sum (30 تمرين + 30 راحة مجدولة = 60, with 8 more days held by tickets) and a calendar that explains each day. The light follows whatever needs him. While today is still owed, the green «ابدأ التمرين» is the lit moment, the numeral stays unlit and the flame is an outline. Once today counts, the flame fills, the numeral gets the floodlight cone and the green button steps down. Every state is read from the last rows of the engine's own ledger (src/recovery.js:278-315), so the screen cannot claim something the engine does not do. Deload is shown truthfully as not protecting the streak (src/deload.js:3-4), and tickets are shown as automatic insurance, because the app has no manual spend (App.jsx:505-530). Today the pill is identical whether he is safe, frozen or at risk (state-credit-spent.png vs state-credit-warning.png). The redesign fixes that, along with the silent breaks and the buried, developer-only "why" panel.

placement.surface: Home: scoreboard (the hero, above the fold)
placement.what:
Order on iPhone 13 (390x844pt, 16pt gutters, 358pt content width): a 52pt header (wordmark right; timer and settings left; no streak chip), then the scoreboard, borderless on #030404 and about 242pt tall, then a 1px #282D33 hairline, then the Today stage. The green CTA lands near y=500pt, well above the 761pt fold. Below a 700pt viewport height the numeral drops to 72pt and the strip is hidden (it stays in the sheet).
(a) EYEBROW, 20pt row. Right: «الستريك» in Changa 600 13pt #8A95A1. Centre, only during a deload: a graphite chip #1D2126, 24pt tall, «ديلود · 3 من 7» in Changa 12pt #B0B9C3. Left: tickets, as Phosphor Ticket 16pt #3B9DE8 + Archivo 600 17pt tabular #3B9DE8 «4» + Changa 13pt #8A95A1 «تذاكر». At zero it reads «0 تذاكر · الجاية بعد 3», all in #8A95A1. These are shown as a number, not slots, so there is never a second five-mark meter.
(b) NUMERAL. Archivo Condensed 800, 96pt (the Floodlight poster scale), 88pt line-height, tabular figures, letter-spacing -1, always #F97316 and never recoloured by state. The unit «يوم» sits on the baseline to its left in Changa 600 17pt #B0B9C3. To its right is one Phosphor Fire glyph, sized by milestone stage (28/36/44pt). It is FILLED when today has counted and drawn as a 1.5pt OUTLINE while today is still owed. Badges on the flame: Moon 16pt #3B9DE8 on a plan-rest day, Ticket 16pt #3B9DE8 when the last closed day was ticketed, Hourglass 18pt #F97316 in the late window. At 0 the numeral itself is a 1.5pt orange outline (unlit).
(c) STATUS. One sentence in Changa 600 17pt #F4F6F8 saying what today does to the number, with a trailing CaretLeft 14pt #8A95A1 to show it is tappable.
(d) DEADLINE/COST. Up to two lines of Changa 400 14pt #B0B9C3. Countdown digits are Archivo 600 tabular, driven by nextDayTurn() (day.js:50-55), and the ticket icon appears inline in #3B9DE8.
(e) 7-DAY CHAIN from ledger.slice(-7) (recovery.js:278-315), oldest on the right and today on the left. Seven 44pt cells with 8pt gaps. Glyphs: trained = 10pt filled #F97316 dot; plan rest = Moon 14pt #3B9DE8; ticket = Ticket 14pt #3B9DE8; miss = X 12pt #8A95A1; today owed = 14pt #F97316 ring at 1.5pt; today counted = filled dot with a 2pt ring; before any history = 6pt #282D33 dot. 2pt connectors: solid #F97316 at 40% between counted days, dashed #3B9DE8 through ticket days, and NO line across a miss, so the run visibly cuts. Labels are Changa 11pt #8A95A1 weekday letters (ح ن ث ر خ ج س), with «اليوم» in #F4F6F8.
