designs.explainer:
The «ليش 60؟» sheet opens from the scoreboard, the header chip, the session row and Profile; toasts open it on a specific day. It is a full-height sheet (92%) on #14171B with a grabber and a Phosphor X (20pt). Sections are divided by 1px #282D33 hairlines, with 16pt gutters, and the sheet scrolls.

1 HEAD: «الستريك» in Changa 13pt #8A95A1; a 56pt Archivo 800 #F97316 numeral + «يوم» in 17pt #B0B9C3 + the flame stage and its name in 13pt («لهب»). Then «60 يوم التزمت فيها بالخطة، من الجمعة 1 مايو» in 15pt #F4F6F8.

2 THE SUM (the core answer). Right-aligned rows, numbers in Archivo 600 22pt tabular, labels in Changa 15pt:
  orange dot  «30 تمرين»
  blue moon   «+ 30 راحة مجدولة»
  hairline, then in orange: «= 60 الستريك»
  muted rows in #8A95A1:
  blue ticket   «8 أيام غطّتها التذاكر — توقّفه وما تزيده»
  outline ring  «1 اليوم — ينتظر تمرينك»
  footer, 13pt: «= 69 يوم من 1 مايو. الستريك مو أيام التقويم ولا عدد الجلسات.»
These are the real veteran-fixture values: a computeRecovery probe on 2026-07-08 gave 30 trained + 30 plan rest = 60, 8 paid, today pending, 69 calendar days. Every row is counted from ledger rows with inRun=true.

3 TODAY: the same status, deadline and cost strings as the scoreboard.

4 CALENDAR: a Gregorian month grid starting on Sunday, 7 columns of 44pt cells, using Home's glyphs. Swipe back to streakStart and earlier; days before the run are dimmed, so the previous run and its break are visible.
Legend: «● تمرين +1 · ☾ راحة مجدولة +1 · تذكرة +0 · ✕ فات بدون تذكرة = انكسر».
Tapping a cell shows a 14pt caption under the grid:
«الأحد 28 يونيو · تمرّنت · +1 صار 59»
«الاثنين 29 يونيو · راحة مجدولة · +1 صار 60»
«الخميس 2 يوليو · يوم تمرين ما تمرّنت فيه · انصرفت تذكرة · وقف على 60»
«الأربعاء 8 يوليو · اليوم · باقي تمرين لين 3 الفجر»
«الأحد 12 يوليو · يوم تمرين بدون تمرين ولا تذكرة · انكسر ستريك 60»
«غيّرت الخطة للمرة الثانية خلال 30 يوم · بدأ ستريك جديد»

5 TICKETS, all in #3B9DE8: the title «تذاكر الراحة» and a big «4» in Archivo 34pt. Rules in 14pt #B0B9C3:
«كل 5 أيام التزام = تذكرة.»
«تنصرف لحالها لو فاتك يوم تمرين، وتوقّف الستريك: ما يزيد ولا ينكسر.»
«لو انكسر الستريك تروح التذاكر معه.»
Progress: five 8pt pips (creditProgress) + «باقي 2 أيام للتذكرة الجاية». History: «انصرفت 8 · آخرها الثلاثاء 7 يوليو».

6 RECORDS: «أفضل ستريك 60 · 1 مايو – اليوم» and «المحطة الجاية 75 · باقي 15 يوم التزام».

7 RULES, each with a 16pt Phosphor icon in #8A95A1, Changa 14pt #B0B9C3. Every line is true of the current code:
«ينحسب اليوم إذا حفظت جلسة وحدة على الأقل، أو كان راحة مجدولة.»
«اليوم التدريبي من 3 الفجر لين 3 الفجر، والجلسة تنحسب لليوم اللي بدأتها فيه.»
«جلسة بدون ولا سيت ما تنحفظ ولا تنحسب.»
««تخطي اليوم» ينقل الخطة بس — يوم التمرين يبي تمرين أو تذكرة.»
«الديلود يخفّف الوزن، ما يحمي الستريك.»
«تغيير الخطة أو عدد الأيام: مرة مجانية كل 30 يوم، والثانية تبدأ ستريك جديد.» followed by a live «(عندك تغيير مجاني)» or «(المجاني بعد 12 يوم)» from changeCooldownLeft (recovery.js:53-57).
«حذف جلسة يرجّع يومها بدون تمرين، وممكن ينزل الستريك.»

8 «وش تغيّر»: non-daily changes only, one 14pt row each, e.g. «8 أكتوبر · من 30 إلى 6 · رجعت جلسات من نسخة احتياطية». This is how a 30-to-6 drop explains itself.

9 FOOTER: the link «السجل يوم بيوم ›» opens the full-run ledger, which replaces RestLedgerPanel. Columns are in Arabic («التاريخ · المطلوب · اللي صار · الستريك · التذاكر»), dates are Gregorian with Latin digits, and copy-as-text is kept.

The sheet does NOT say "add the session later and the streak comes back": the app has no way to add a past-dated session.
designs.milestones:
One glyph in one colour: Phosphor Fire in #F97316, growing only in size. There are no hearts and no green or blue tiers, because in Floodlight green means action and blue means rest. The five-mark CommitmentFlames meter and its level names (constants.js:217-225; HomePage.jsx:92-122) are removed, so nothing next to the number can be mistaken for a ticket count.

STAGES:
- 0: outline numeral + 28pt outline ember.
- «جمرة» (1-6): 28pt.
- «شعلة» (7-29): 36pt.
- «لهب» (30-99): 44pt.
- «مشعل» (100+): 44pt + a 1.5pt #F97316 halo ring, 60pt across, at 30%.

MOMENTS use the existing STREAK_MILESTONES (7, 10, 14, 21, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 100, 120, 150, 180, 200, 250, 300, 365, then every 100; utils.js:630, 642). Each fires exactly once, tracked by hf_streak_seen.
- BIG, at a stage change or a year (7, 30, 100, 365, then every 100): a full-screen takeover. It appears after the session that crosses the value, or on first open of the plan-rest day that reaches it (rest days count from 03:00). It has a 96pt numeral, one cone bloom, the badge if one unlocks the same day (c2=7, c4=30, c6=100), a green «احفظ البوستر» that opens the milestone poster, and a quiet «بعدين».
- SMALL, all other values: the numeral beat on Home, the status line «محطة 60 — الجاية 75», and the greeting's milestone pool for that day.
The sheet always shows «المحطة الجاية 75 · باقي 15 يوم التزام». Achievements show «60 من 100».

COPY: 7 «أسبوع كامل على خطتك — صارت شعلة» · 30 «شهر التزام — صار لهب» · 100 «100 يوم — صار مشعل» · 365 «سنة كاملة على الخطة» · otherwise «وصلت 60 — الجاية 75».

Milestones are counted in the 🔥 unit (eligible days), the same number as the scoreboard, never in sessions.
designs.notifications:
Current reality: the scheduler sets fixed slots (08:00, 12:30, 15:30, workout hour, 21:00) with setTimeout, so they fire only while the app is alive (utils.js:502-540). None of them knows the streak, and the 21:00 message asks about training even on a rest day (constants.js:1040-1048).

PLAN:
1) At most one streak reminder per workout day, at 23:00 local (4 hours before 03:00). It is sent only if today's ledger row is pending on a workout day and no session is active. It is never sent on a plan rest, override, completed day or first day. It uses tag 'streak', so a newer one replaces it.
   - No ticket: title «ستريكك 60 بخطر», body «باقي 4 ساعات لين 3 الفجر وما عندك تذاكر. ابدأ جلسة قبل 3 وتنحسب.»
   - With a ticket: title «ستريكك 60 · باقي 4 ساعات», body «لو ما تمرّنت الليلة تنصرف تذكرة ويوقف على 60 (يبقى 3).»
2) The 21:00 'evening' and workout-hour nudges are suppressed on counted days.
3) Spends, breaks and milestones get no push. They are told in-app on the next open (ribbon, band or takeover), where the sum and the calendar can explain them. The spend toast carries the date and the balance (see placement).
4) Delivery: through the existing scheduler this is best-effort only, while the PWA is open or recently backgrounded. Arriving with the app closed needs Web Push and a sender, and the app is currently a static site with no backend. An optional app-icon badge (navigator.setAppBadge) can be set when the app is backgrounded on an owed workout day and cleared on the next counted state.
5) All toasts sit at the bottom above the tab bar, never over the header or scoreboard.
newData: recovery.today = {kind: 'counted-trained' | 'counted-rest' | 'owed' | 'paid', counted: bool}, derived from the last ledger row (recovery.js:278-315: kind, completed, scheduled, pending). Keying off the ledger instead of status is what makes the override and completed days correct.

usableCredits = creditsEarned − creditsSpent, uncapped, because that is what auto-spend reads (recovery.js:239). Also ifMissedToday = usableCredits ≥ 1 ? 'ticket' : 'break'. Before «يبقى N» can be true, decide whether to enforce MAX_REST_CREDITS in the engine or drop the display clamp (recovery.js:312, 318).
Current-run breakdown from ledger rows with inRun=true: trained, plannedRest, paid, and calendarDays = dayDiff(streakStart, today) + 1. Feeds the sheet's sum.
heldRun: the count and dates of consecutive paid days ending yesterday, from the ledger (for «8 أيام ورا بعض»).

runs[] and bestStreak: record each run in computeRecovery's forward walk at restart(i) (recovery.js:229), as {start, end, length in 🔥 units, endedBy: 'miss' | 'settings', on}. bestStreak = max(runs, current). Also persist a high-water mark hf_streak_best {value, start, end}, because the replay is capped at 400 days (recovery.js:131-133) and ledger rows outside the run have streak = null (recovery.js:309-313).
tomorrowExpected ('workout' | 'rest'): one forward step of the cycle, using patternForDay(tomorrow) and the position and consecutive count after today.

A minute ticker for the countdown on the scoreboard and header chip, from nextDayTurn() (day.js:50-55); only a day-turn timer exists today (App.jsx:544-548). Plus lateWindow = local time between 23:00 and 02:59.
hf_streak_seen {value, day, milestonesCelebrated[]}, stored. It fires the +1 beat and each milestone exactly once, and detects changes that did not come from a day passing.

hf_streak_changes [{day, from, to, reason}], stored, last 20. Reasons are written by the history restore (App.jsx:71-99, alongside hf_history_restore_report), backup import (App.jsx:986-990), session delete (WorkoutPage.jsx:478), settings reset (App.jsx:727) and a break (brokenBy).

Provisional day for an active session: dayKey(hf_active.date). A session that crosses 03:00 is shown as «تنحسب ليوم …», and that day's spend or break is neither displayed nor toasted until the session is saved or discarded.
Delete preview: consistencyStreak recomputed without the chosen session, for the delete confirm.
nextMilestone and daysToNextMilestone, derived from STREAK_MILESTONES (utils.js:630).
A Gregorian date formatter with Latin digits for every streak date, replacing fmtDate 'ar-SA' (utils.js:94-103).
Report and poster in 🔥 units: month-end value (endStreak already exists), best this month, and all-time best from runs[]; the poster tile reads endStreak (reportPoster.js:190).
TodayHero receives the recovery status (COMPLETED, override) as a new input, not stored data (HomePage.jsx:182-199).
Web Push subscription and a sender, only if the 23:00 reminder must arrive while the PWA is closed (the app is a static Vercel site with no backend).
risks: The owner believes deload weeks protect the streak and that he can spend rest credits himself. The code does neither: deload is ignored by the engine (deload.js:3-4), and credits spend themselves with no manual action (App.jsx:505-530). The design states the real rules. If he wants deload protection or a «خذ راحة» button, that is an engine change, and the UI must not hint at it (no calm droplets).

Session crossing 03:00: computeRecovery reads only hf_sessions (App.jsx:497). From 03:01 until a session started at 02:50 is saved, the previous day reads as a miss, so a ticket can be auto-spent with a toast, or a break shown, which then heals when the session is saved. This must be handled (provisional day) before the scoreboard ships, or the hero will show a false break at the worst moment.
The 5-ticket cap is cosmetic (recovery.js:239 vs 312, 318). «يبقى 5» while tickets are being spent looks broken, so the cap needs a decision before the ticket copy ships.
Notifications cannot be reliable without a push backend. setTimeout reminders do not fire when an iOS PWA is closed (utils.js:521-537), so the reminder must not be presented as a guarantee.

Night pressure and nagging: the countdown stays at 14pt #B0B9C3 until 23:00, the hourglass appears only in the late window, nothing is red, and there is at most one reminder a day. Escalate information, not guilt.

Two loud elements on Home (a 96pt orange numeral and the green CTA). The lit rule (cone only when there is no green action; outline flame while owed) has to be checked on a device at real brightness and in sunlight.
Small screens: below a 700pt viewport the numeral drops to 72pt and the strip moves into the sheet, so the CTA stays above the fold (iPhone SE 375x667).
Showing 0 instead of hiding the number (fresh, broken) can sting. The outline numeral and «أفضل ستريك 60 — محفوظ» soften it, but best-streak data must exist first.

Changing the report and poster from «أطول سلسلة» (sessions, e.g. 16) to «الستريك» (eligible days, e.g. 31 for the same March) changes what old posters meant. Use the new label so the change does not read as another unexplained jump like 30 to 6.
Bidi: mixed Arabic and Latin-digit strings («من 30 إلى 6», «باقي 9:40», «(يبقى 3)») need <bdi>/LTR spans and Archivo tabular figures, or the digits reorder.
The greeting will keep contradicting the scoreboard unless greetingPoolFor (utils.js:636-644) ranks creditSpent and held-run above comeback when the streak is above 0.
The 400-day replay cap (recovery.js:131-133) caps the streak at about 401. Persist the best value and widen the window long before he gets near it (he is at 60 in the fixture).

The benchmark's 'add the forgotten session and the streak returns' cannot be promised: there is no way to add or edit a past-dated session (only delete, WorkoutPage.jsx:474-484). Backfill would be a separate feature.

designs.name: شريط الأسبوع (Week Strip): عدد الستريك مع شريط 7 أيام وجملة واحدة عن اليوم، فوق «Today stage» في الرئيسية
designs.thesis: On Home the streak takes the first block under the header, above the Today stage. It has three parts. (1) The count, as a 56px Archivo numeral in --streak. Its flame says whether today has counted yet: filled means counted, outline means not yet. (2) A 7-day strip that shows why the number is what it is. Each day gets a glyph and a delta: +1 trained, +1 plan rest, 0 held by a ticket, a cut chain for a break, and a dashed cell for today while it is pending. (3) One sentence on what today will do to the number before 03:00. The Today stage then says what skipping costs, right under the green action. Every other place the streak appears (header chip, workout, Profile, report, poster, notifications) uses the same number, name and colour, and each one opens the same sheet. That sheet answers «ليش 60؟» as a sum of days and shows a day-by-day calendar back to the start of the run, so a drop like 30→6 can be explained in one tap. Every state comes from data the engine already produces (the ledger rows in recovery.js:278-315: kind, inRun, pending, streakDelta; plus wasDeloadDay deload.js:150-158 and nextDayTurn day.js:50-55). The design never promises protection the code does not give: deload, «تخطي اليوم» and the choice of when to use a ticket are all stated honestly.

placement.surface: Home: streak band («الستريك»). First block under the global header, above the Today stage. Header chip hidden on Home.
placement.what: No box. Ground #030404, 1px #1D2126 hairline top and bottom, padding 16pt top and bottom, 16pt side gutters (358pt content at 390pt). The whole band is one button (aria-label «الستريك 60 يوم. اليوم ما انحسب لسا. باقي لك 3 تذاكر. اضغط للتفاصيل») that opens the streak sheet. ROW A, 56pt: at the RTL start, Phosphor Flame 30pt (fill when today has counted, regular/outline while pending) in #F97316, 6pt gap, numeral in Archivo SemiCondensed 800 56/56 tabular-nums with letter-spacing −1.5 in #F97316, 6pt gap, «يوم» in Changa 600 16/20 #B0B9C3 on the numeral baseline. At the RTL end, a two-line stack: «المحطة الجاية» in Changa 11/14 #8A95A1, then «75» in Archivo 700 20/24 #B0B9C3 + « · باقي 15» in Changa 11 #8A95A1 (next item of STREAK_MILESTONES, utils.js:630). ROW B, 6pt below, min 22pt, max 2 lines: the state sentence in Changa 500 15/22, #F4F6F8 by default, #F97316 in the late break-risk window, and the ticket fragment in #3B9DE8. Times such as «2:40» sit in an LTR-isolated span. ROW C, 14pt below, 68pt: the strip, 7 columns of 51pt, oldest at the right, today at the left end. Each column has a weekday label (Changa 11/14 #8A95A1; today reads «اليوم» in Changa 600 #F4F6F8), a 6pt gap, a 32pt glyph circle, a 4pt gap, and a delta in Archivo 700 11/14 («+1» #F97316, «0» #3B9DE8, «—» or «كسر» #8A95A1). A 2pt chain line runs through the circle centres: solid #F97316 between counted days, dashed 2/4 #3B9DE8 into and out of a ticket day, dashed #F97316 at 50% into today's pending cell, and no line across a break. During a deload, a bracket (1pt #8A95A1 with 4pt end ticks) sits 6pt under the deltas of the deload days with «ديلود · اليوم 3 من 7» in Changa 11 #8A95A1 (+18pt). ROW D, 12pt below, 20pt: at the start, 5 Phosphor Ticket 14 slots, filled #3B9DE8 per usable ticket and outline #282D33 when empty; above 5 it shows 5 filled + «+3» in Archivo 12 #3B9DE8. Then «3 تذاكر · وحدة جديدة بعد يومين» in Changa 12/16 #B0B9C3 with the count in #3B9DE8. At the end, «ليش 60؟» in Changa 600 13 #B0B9C3 + Phosphor CaretLeft 12. Total height about 230pt. With an 84pt header the band ends near y=314pt and the CTA lands near y=470pt, well above the nav at y=761pt. Order rule: nothing may be inserted between the header and the band. The deload suggestion (HomePage.jsx:202-206), the month-report strip and the plan card all go below the Today stage. This band replaces the old gamification strip (HomePage.jsx:208-236): the 5 commitment marks and their droplets are removed, and rank/Lv/XP move below the Today stage as their own row with no flame.

placement.surface: Home: Today stage (TodayHero), consequence line and «تخطي اليوم»
placement.what: (a) One line under the secondary button pair, 10pt below, Changa 13/18 #B0B9C3 with a 14pt Phosphor icon at the start. It shows only on a pending workout day with streak ≥ 1. Ticket case (Ticket #3B9DE8): «لو ما تمرّنت قبل 3 الفجر: تنصرف تذكرة ويوقف على 60.» Break case (Hourglass #F97316; text turns #F97316 from 21:00): «لو ما تمرّنت قبل 3 الفجر: يرجع الستريك 0.» From 21:00 in the break case it becomes «ابدأ قبل 3 وتنحسب لليوم، حتى لو خلّصت بعدها.» This is true because session.date is stamped at start (App.jsx:367, 392; day.js:2-3). (b) Done state, which TodayHero cannot draw today because it only receives isRecoveryDay (HomePage.jsx:182-199). Status pill «خلصت اليوم», the green CTA becomes a quiet hairline button «تمرين إضافي», and there is no consequence line. This also removes the false alarm, which today fires after training (HomePage.jsx:152-153). (c) Rest stage: the streak sentence in TodayHero.jsx:225 is dropped because the band now carries it. «غداً: Pull Day» stays. (d) «تخطي اليوم» (App.jsx:382-385) opens a confirm sheet (#14171B, two quiet buttons, no green). Title «تخطي اليوم ينقل الخطة بس». Body, ticket case: «الستريك لسا ينتظر تمرين اليوم. لو ما تمرّنت قبل 3 الفجر تنصرف تذكرة (يبقى لك 2).» Body, break case: «الستريك لسا ينتظر تمرين اليوم. لو ما تمرّنت قبل 3 الفجر ينكسر الستريك 60.» Buttons «انقل الخطة» / «رجوع». The alert becomes «انتقلت الخطة لليوم الجاي — الستريك لسا ينتظر تمرين». (e) The gold «🎟️ 4» chip (TodayHero.jsx:199-207) is removed because Row D of the band now carries tickets, in blue.

placement.surface: Global header chip, every tab except Home, and during a workout (replaces App.jsx:805-813)
placement.what: A real <button> that opens the streak sheet. Capsule 32pt high, padding 0 10pt, 1px #282D33 hairline, radius 16, transparent fill, 44×44 hit area, white-space:nowrap (fixes the flame stacking over the number in page-home.png). Content: Phosphor Flame 16 + Archivo 700 17px tabular in #F97316. Variants: counted = Flame fill. Pending = Flame regular. Break-risk window (21:00–03:00, no ticket) = Flame regular + Phosphor Hourglass fill 12 #F97316 after the number. Plan-rest day = Flame fill + Moon fill 10 #3B9DE8 at the top end of the flame. 0 = Flame regular #8A95A1 + «0» #8A95A1; it is never hidden, so a break can never pass silently. aria-label «الستريك 60 يوم، اليوم ما انحسب لسا». Deload does not change it.

An inline token after «sets 0/5» in the same row: Phosphor Flame regular 14 #F97316 + «61» in Archivo 700 13 #F97316 + «عند الإنهاء» in Changa 12 #8A95A1. Variants: no set counts yet (the normalizeSession/setCounts rule, sets.js:44-56) = «سجّل مجموعة وحدة عشان ينحسب اليوم» in #8A95A1. Today already counted (a plan rest, or a second session) = «اليوم محسوب» in #8A95A1. Session started before 03:00 and it is now after = «تنحسب لأمس — بديتها قبل 3 الفجر». Settings-reset day = token hidden. The «DELOAD · −40%» pill becomes «ديلود · −40%» and never touches the token. The header chip stays visible above.

finishSession already switches to Home (App.jsx:465). Today's cell goes from dashed ring to solid #F97316 disc (scale 0.6→1, 300ms ease-out), the chain draws into it (200ms), and the numeral ticks once from 60 to 61 (400ms), then everything rests. With prefers-reduced-motion it is instant. Row B switches to the counted copy. The toast «جلسة مكتملة! عمل رائع!» (App.jsx:466) becomes «انحفظت الجلسة — الستريك 61». When the day was already counted: «انحفظت الجلسة — اليوم كان محسوب». An empty session keeps «الجلسة فاضية — ما انكتب فيها ولا وزن، فما انحفظت» and adds « — اليوم ما انحسب».

placement.surface: Streak sheet (the explainer). Entry from the band, header chip, Profile section, achievement badge, report streak block, and the one-time break/changed cards
placement.what: Large-detent bottom sheet on #14171B with a grabber, title «الستريك» in Changa 600 17 #F4F6F8, and a close X. Content is described in the explainer field. It replaces Settings › «سجل المكافأة (تشخيص)» (RestLedgerPanel.jsx, SettingsPage.jsx:1097). Settings keeps only a link row «الستريك يوم بيوم ‹» that opens this sheet.

placement.surface: Profile (replaces «إيقاع التدريب» tiles and «أفضل streak», ProfilePage.jsx:412-434)
placement.what: Section «الستريك», hairline-separated. Row 1: Flame fill 20 + numeral in Archivo 800 40px #F97316 + «يوم», then «بدأ الأحد 9 أغسطس» in Changa 13 #B0B9C3. Row 2: «أطول ستريك 60 · الحالي» in Changa 13 #B0B9C3 with the number in Archivo #F4F6F8 (needs runs/best, see newData; until then the row is hidden instead of showing the false bestStreak = streak, ProfilePage.jsx:72). Row 3: a 5-week mini grid, 35 cells of 14pt circles with 6pt gaps, in the strip's glyph language (no deltas), today last. The pattern line uses a plural helper («تمرين واحد ثم راحة», «تمرينين ثم راحة», «3 تمارين ثم راحة») instead of «1 تمارين» (ProfilePage.jsx:420). «أفضل streak» is removed from «إحصائيات كاملة».

Badges c1–c6 keep their thresholds of 3/7/14/30/60/100 and their «تمريناً أو راحة» definition. The next locked badge shows a 2pt progress bar in #F97316 with «60 / 100 · باقي 40 يوم» in Archivo 12 / Changa 12 #8A95A1. The icon ladder becomes one Phosphor Flame drawn at the badge's tier size instead of 🔥/🌙/⚡/🌟. Tapping a streak badge opens the streak sheet at «المحطات».

The streak block uses the Home unit (eligible days) and Home name. The ring and rows «هذا الشهر / الشهر الماضي / الأطول» are titled «الستريك» and drawn in #F97316. The tip «رصيدك ممتلئ… بدل أن يضيع» (monthReport.js:640) is removed because it is false. The first report after the switch carries one line: «رقم الستريك هنا صار نفس رقم الرئيسية (كان يحسب الجلسات بس).»

Monthly: the blue «16 أطول سلسلة» tile becomes «60 يوم ستريك», numeral in #F97316 (endStreak, monthReport.js:267), with «مستمر» in Changa 11 #8A95A1 under it when the run is still going. Milestone poster (major milestones only, opened from «احفظها صورة»): 1080×1920 canvas (360×640pt @3x) on #030404. Phosphor Flame fill 64pt #F97316 centred at y=180pt. Numeral in Archivo 800 96pt (288px) #F97316, tabular. «يوم ستريك» in Changa 600 22 #F4F6F8. «44 تمرين · 16 راحة بالخطة» in Changa 15 #B0B9C3; the two parts always add up to the numeral. «من 9 أغسطس 2026» in Changa 13 #8A95A1. Footer «حمزة · مران» in Changa 13 #8A95A1 + wordmark. No gold, no green, no glow beyond a single 40% orange radial behind the flame.

Copy names every day, the number and the balance, and drops the Hijri/Arabic-Indic dates. One day: «انصرفت تذكرة عن الأحد 4 أكتوبر — الستريك وقف على 60. باقي لك 3 تذاكر.» Several days: «انصرفت 3 تذاكر (2، 3، 4 أكتوبر) — الستريك وقف على 60. باقي لك تذكرة وحدة.» The toast must not cover the band: it anchors at the bottom above the nav, not over the header (overlay-system-alert.png). The record stays visible afterwards as the blue ticket cells in the strip and the sheet calendar.

placement.surface: History: session delete confirm (App.jsx:477-479, WorkoutPage HistoryView)
placement.what: Before deleting, dry-run computeRecovery without that session. If the streak or tickets would change, the confirm states it: «حذف هذي الجلسة يخلّي الأحد 4 أكتوبر يوم غياب — تنصرف تذكرة ويوقف الستريك على 59.» or «…— ينكسر الستريك 60.» Buttons «احذف» / «رجوع». Otherwise the existing confirm is used unchanged.

It must not contradict the band. While the streak is alive because tickets held the missing days, the comeback pool («الغياب انتهى…») must not be picked. Use creditSpent/frozen lines such as «التذاكر وقفت الستريك على 60 يا حمزة — اليوم نكمّل». The 🔥 emoji is removed from greetings that are not about the streak (constants.js:24, 27, 49, 61, 92).

states.visual: Numeral «0» #8A95A1 with Flame regular #8A95A1. Strip: 6 dotted empty cells (1pt #282D33) and today's cell as a dashed #F97316 ring with Barbell. Row D: 5 empty ticket slots. Header chip on other tabs: grey «0», visible. No commitment marks.
states.copyAr: Row B: «أول جلسة تحفظها تبدأ الستريك.» Second line, #8A95A1, 13: «الستريك = أيام التزامك بالخطة: تمرين أو راحة بالخطة.» Row D: «أول تذكرة بعد 5 أيام»

designs.explainer:
STREAK SHEET («الستريك»): the single tap-through surface. It answers «ليش هالرقم؟» from the ledger computeRecovery already writes (recovery.js:278-315), so it cannot drift from the number. Large-detent bottom sheet on #14171B, 16pt gutters, sections separated by 1px #1D2126 hairlines with no boxes, section titles in Changa 600 15 #F4F6F8. Dates are Gregorian with Western digits («الأحد 9 أغسطس»), never fmtDate ar-SA Hijri (utils.js:94-103).

1) HERO. Flame 36 (fill or regular by today's state) + numeral in Archivo 800 56px #F97316 + «يوم» in Changa 16 #B0B9C3. Below it, the same Row B sentence as the band. Then the start line in Changa 13 #B0B9C3, chosen by cause:
- «بدأ الأحد 9 أغسطس — بعد غياب السبت 8 أغسطس بدون تذكرة.» (brokenBy = day before streakStart)
- «بدأ الأحد 9 أغسطس — بعد تغيير الخطة السبت 8 أغسطس.» (streakResetAt)
- «بدأ الأحد 9 أغسطس — من أول جلسة سجّلتها.» (streakStart = first session)

2) «ليش 60؟»: the arithmetic, read from the ledger rows inRun. Line 1, numbers in Archivo 700 22: «44 تمرين + 16 راحة بالخطة = 60». Counted parts in #F97316, operators in #8A95A1. Trained = completed && inRun && streakDelta 1; plan rest = the eligible rows not completed. The two always add up to consistencyStreak. Line 2 in Changa 13 #B0B9C3 with the number in #3B9DE8: «و8 أيام وقف فيها بتذاكر — ما تنحسب وما تكسر.» (spentInStreak). Shown only when paid > 0.

3) «يوم بيوم»: the calendar from the month of streakStart to today, newest month first. Month header in Changa 13 #8A95A1. 7 columns of 44pt cells with 28pt glyphs in the strip's language: orange disc + Barbell = trained +1; orange ring + blue Moon = plan rest +1; dashed blue ring + Ticket = held 0; grey X with cut chain = break; grey ArrowCounterClockwise = settings reset; dashed orange = today pending. Earlier runs in the replay window are drawn at 35% for context. Deload days have a 2pt #8A95A1 underline (wasDeloadDay, deload.js:150-158). A legend sits under the first month: «تمرين +1 · راحة بالخطة +1 · تذكرة 0 · انكسر · اليوم». Tapping a day expands one sentence under its week (Changa 14/20 #F4F6F8):
- trained: «الثلاثاء 22 يوليو — تمرّنت: +1، صار 58.»
- plan rest: «… — راحة بالخطة: +1، صار 58.»
- trained on a plan rest: «… — كان راحة بالخطة وتمرّنت: +1، صار 58. الراحة انتقلت لبكرة.» (recovery.js:144, 151-152)
- paid: «… — يوم تمرين وما تمرّنت: انصرفت تذكرة، وقف على 58.»
- earned, appended: « وكسبت تذكرة.» (row.earned)
- break: «… — يوم تمرين وما تمرّنت، وما عندك تذكرة: انكسر بعد 60 يوم.»
- reset: «… — تغيير ثاني للخطة خلال 30 يوم: بدأ ستريك جديد.»
- today pending: «اليوم — يوم تمرين، ما انحسب لسا. باقي 2:40 على 3 الفجر.»
- deload, appended: « (ديلود)»

4) «التذاكر». Ticket slots at 18pt, showing the true usable count (creditsEarned − creditsSpent), «+N» past 5. Then «كل 5 أيام تنحسب تكسبك تذكرة. باقي يومين على الجاية (3 من 5).» (creditProgress, daysToNextCredit). Rules in Changa 13 #B0B9C3:
- «إذا غبت يوم تمرين، تنصرف تذكرة لحالها الساعة 3 الفجر: الستريك يوقف وما ينكسر.»
- «إذا ما عندك تذكرة، ينكسر — وتروح التذاكر معه.»
- «ما تختار متى تنصرف؛ تنصرف بنفسها.»

5) «وش ينحسب؟». Eight lines, each with a 16pt Phosphor icon:
- «يوم التمرين ينحسب لما تضغط «إنهاء التمرين» — جلسة وحدة تكفي.»
- «يوم الراحة بالخطة ينحسب من 3 الفجر بدون ما تسوي شي.»
- «اليوم يقفل 3 الفجر: جلسة تبدأها 1 الليل تنحسب لليوم اللي قبله.» (day.js:5-20)
- «تمرّنت بيوم راحة؟ ينحسب، والراحة تنتقل لبكرة.»
- ««تخطي اليوم» ينقل الخطة بس — الستريك لسا ينتظر تمرين.» (App.jsx:382-385)
- «الديلود يخفف الوزن بس — الغياب فيه مثل أي غياب.» (deload.js:3-4)
- «تغيير الخطة أو عدد الأيام: مرة كل 30 يوم مجاناً. التغيير المجاني الجاي: بعد 12 يوم.» Reads «متاح الحين» when changeCooldownLeft is 0 (recovery.js:53-57).
- «حذف جلسة قديمة يعيد حساب الستريك من سجلك.»

6) «المحطات». A horizontal ladder in Archivo 15: the two reached STREAK_MILESTONES with a check, then the next three in #8A95A1. Reached ones are #F97316 and show their date where an achievement unlockedAt exists (c2–c6, App.jsx:300-318), e.g. «30 · 10 سبتمبر». Line: «المحطة الجاية 75 — باقي 15 يوم.»

7) «أطول ستريك». «60 — الحالي», or «74 — من 2 مايو إلى 15 يوليو، انكسر بغياب 16 يوليو», plus up to 3 earlier runs, one line each. Needs runs/best (newData); hidden until it exists.

8) Footer link «السجل الكامل ‹» opens the full-run ledger table, which today is the Settings panel, relabelled in Arabic: «اليوم · الخطة · تمرّنت؟ · الحكم · الستريك · للتذكرة · كسب/صرف · التذاكر». It replaces «في restDays», «الـstreak» and consistencyStreak (restLedger.js:8-11, 34-42), keeps the restore report (RestLedgerPanel.jsx:77-93), and keeps «انسخ السجل» (restLedger.js:45-62).
designs.milestones:
One ladder for everything: STREAK_MILESTONES = 7, 10, 14, 21, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 100, 120, 150, 180, 200, 250, 300, 365 (utils.js:630), counted in streak units (eligible days).

MAJOR (band lit moment + «احفظها صورة» + milestone poster + milestone greeting that day): 7, 14, 30, 60, 100, 200, 365. These match the achievement badges c2–c6 at 7/14/30/60/100 (constants.js:792-822), so a badge and the moment fire on the same day.

MINOR (numeral beat + Row B line «40 يوم — محطة جديدة. الجاية 50.», no poster): 10, 21, 40, 50, 75, 90, 120, 150, 180, 250, 300.

Also: day 1 has its own beat («أول يوم بالستريك: 1…»), and the c1 badge at 3 keeps its achievement toast.

WHEN: on the first render after the last ledger row has streakDelta 1 and lands on a milestone. It plays once, remembered in hf_streak_seen. A milestone reached at 03:00 on a plan-rest day plays at the first open that day. One reached by finishing a session plays on the return to Home (App.jsx:465). A ticket day adds 0 and never triggers one.

GLYPH: the flame does NOT grow or change colour by tier. The earlier ember / flame / green heart / light heart ladder is dropped. The flame's fill already carries today's state (filled = counted, outline = pending), and green and blue mean action and rest in Floodlight. The numeral itself is the tier. The 5 commitment marks and their labels (constants.js:218-225, HomePage.jsx:103-122) are removed.

The sheet's «المحطات» section always shows «المحطة الجاية N — باقي X يوم», and the band shows it at the end of Row A.

Ceiling: the replay is capped at 400 days (recovery.js:131-133). The «every 100 after 365» rule (utils.js:642) is not offered until that cap is lifted.
designs.notifications:
Today's scheduler is state-blind fixed slots (08:00, 12:30, 15:30, workout hour, 21:00) using setTimeout, so it only fires while the PWA is alive (utils.js:502-540). The 21:00 copy «هل أكملت تمرينك اليوم؟» fires even after training or on rest days (constants.js:1040-1048). Proposal, keeping that mechanism and honest about its limit:

1) One streak reminder channel, tag 'streak'. It replaces the 'evening' slot on pending workout days only. Never on a plan-rest day, a counted day, or with no history.
   a) Ticket case (usable ≥ 1), 22:00. Title «الستريك 60 ينتظر تمرين اليوم». Body «لو ما تمرّنت قبل 3 الفجر تنصرف تذكرة. باقي لك 3 تذاكر.»
   b) Break case (usable 0, streak ≥ 1), 21:00. Title «الستريك 60 — ما عندك تذاكر». Body «تمرّن قبل 3 الفجر أو يرجع 0.»
      If still pending at 01:00: title «باقي ساعتين على 3 الفجر», body «ابدأ قبل 3 وتنحسب لليوم — الستريك 60.»
   At most 2 a day. Saving a session cancels pending timers and closes shown notifications with tag 'streak' (getNotifications({tag:'streak'}) then close()).

2) The 'workout' slot is suppressed on plan-rest days.

3) No push for a ticket spend or a milestone. Those are told in-app on the next open: the band's Row B, the dated toast, and the one-time break/changed note. They are the reliable channel.

4) 🔥 is removed from non-streak notifications (constants.js:1010, 1033), so the flame always means the streak.

5) Limit, stated plainly to the owner: on an installed iOS PWA the app is usually suspended at night, so a 21:00/01:00 reminder will mostly not arrive. Reliable delivery needs Web Push (a push subscription plus a small server or cron that computes the state). See newData.
newData: todayStreakState(recovery, now): one selector over the LAST ledger row (recovery.js:284-314). Returns counted (inRun && streakDelta 1), pending (row.pending), held (kind paid), reset (streakResetAt == today), or fresh (empty ledger), plus isPlanRest (scheduled 'rest'). Every surface (band, chip, stage, player, notifications) reads only this.

usableCredits = creditsEarned − creditsSpent (uncapped, recovery.js:270-271, 340-341). Shown instead of restCredits, which is clamped to 5 (recovery.js:318) while auto-spend reads the uncapped value (recovery.js:239). Alternative: make MAX_REST_CREDITS a real engine cap. That is a behaviour change, so it is the owner's decision.

missWouldCost = usableCredits ≥ 1 ? 'ticket' : (consistencyStreak > 0 ? 'break' : 'nothing'). Drives the stage line, the «تخطي اليوم» confirm and the notifications. Replaces atRisk (HomePage.jsx:152-153).
deadline + late window: nextDayTurn() (day.js:50-55), a 60s ticker while the countdown is visible, and lateWindow = local time ≥ 21:00 or < 03:00.

strip7: the last 7 ledger rows, padded at the front with 'beforeHistory' cells. Each cell is mapped to trained / planRest / trainedOnRest / held / pending / break (kind miss && !inRun && !pending) / reset / previousRun (eligible && !inRun), with delta and chain-link type, plus wasDeloadDay(config, date) (deload.js:150-158).

runSummary for the current run: trainedInRun, planRestInRun (these two sum to consistencyStreak), paidInRun (= spentInStreak), frozenDays (count of trailing paid rows before today), and startCause (miss / reset / firstSession / window edge).

runs[] in streak units over the replay window: {start, end, length, paid, endedBy: 'miss'|'reset'|null, endDate}. Computed in the same forward walk (recovery.js:221-248) or as an eligible-unit variant of streakRuns (monthReport.js:163-181) that also breaks on streakResetAt. Feeds «أطول ستريك», the run list and the report rows.
hf_streak_best {value, start, end}: a persisted high-water mark, so the best survives the 400-day replay window. It is a record, not an input to the engine.

hf_streak_seen {day, value, start, milestoneShown}: detects a number that changed for a reason other than a day passing (break, reset, restore, delete, import) and plays the milestone moment exactly once. The cause comes from hf_history_restore_report (App.jsx:92-96), a 'lastDelete' marker written by deleteSession, and an import marker.
milestone helpers: nextMilestone(streak), isMilestoneToday (last row streakDelta 1 && STREAK_MILESTONES.has(streak)), MAJOR_MILESTONES = {7,14,30,60,100,200,365}.

tomorrowExpected forecast: one more step of the cycle walk beyond today (recovery.js:139-164 stops at today, line 149). Used only for the counted_trained copy; that copy falls back to «تمرين اليوم انحسب.» without it.
TodayHero props: todayStreakState + missWouldCost + usableCredits, so it can draw the done state and the consequence line (today it only gets isRecoveryDay and restCredits, HomePage.jsx:182-199).
In-session: countsForYesterday = dayKey(active.date) !== todayKey(), and hasCountingSet (setCounts / normalizeSession dry-run, sets.js:44-56) for the player token.
Delete preview: computeRecovery(sessionsWithout(id), cfg) before deleting, to show the cost in the confirm.
Greeting input: streakHeldByTickets (frozenDays > 0 || paid yesterday), so greetingPoolFor (utils.js:636-644) never picks 'comeback' while the streak is alive.
Formatting: a Gregorian, Western-digit date formatter for every streak date (Intl 'ar-SA-u-ca-gregory-nu-latn'), and an Arabic plural helper for يوم / تذكرة / تمرين (1, 2, 3–10, 11+).

Web Push: a push subscription plus a tiny server or cron that evaluates missWouldCost at 21:00/22:00/01:00 local, for notifications that arrive while the PWA is suspended. Without it the reminders are in-app timers only.

Report: endStreak (monthReport.js:267) used on the poster and in the report header, and eligible-unit runs used for «هذا الشهر / الشهر الماضي / الأطول» (replacing session units, monthReport.js:153-181).
risks: The 400-day replay cap (recovery.js:131-133) means a streak past about 401 cannot be represented, and the 365 milestone sits close to that edge. The cap must be lifted, or the replay chunked, before the band can be trusted at that length.

Showing the true ticket balance (e.g. 8) breaks the old '5 max' story, and tests only check the clamped value (tests/recovery-credits.test.mjs:88-100). If the owner wants 5 to be a real cap instead, that changes which misses get absorbed, so it is an engine decision and not a UI fix.

Deload does not protect the streak (deload.js:2-4; tests/deload.test.mjs:9-10), but the owner believes it does. The design says so plainly. If he wants protection, the engine has to change, and the band must not imply it does in the meantime.

Tickets are spent automatically. There is no 'use a ticket' or 'keep my tickets' action (App.jsx:505-530 is the only writer of restDays). The owner's phrase «تذاكر راحة he can spend» may expect control. The design describes the tickets as automatic and never adds a button the engine cannot honour.

On an installed iOS PWA, reminders at 21:00 and 01:00 will mostly not arrive without Web Push infrastructure, because setTimeout only runs while the app is alive (utils.js:521-537). The band is the reliable channel.

Hiding the header chip on Home only works if the band is always the first block. A future card inserted above it (the deload suggestion, month strip, or 'what's new') would push the number down and repeat the old failure. The ordering needs a test.
Switching the report and poster to streak units changes visible numbers (e.g. «أطول سلسلة» 16 becomes 31). That is the 30→6 shock in reverse unless the one-time explanation line ships with it.
The 21:00 escalation threshold is an assumption. His sessions run late and the gym closes at 3, so the threshold may need to follow profile.workoutTime / WORKOUT_TIME_HOURS.
The flame now encodes today's state (outline vs fill), so it cannot also show tier. The earlier ember→heart growth is deliberately dropped, and the owner may miss it.

At 320–360pt widths the strip cells shrink to about 41pt. Full weekday names («ثلاثاء», «أربعاء») at 11px may clip, so two-letter fallbacks are needed. The 56px numeral at 3 digits plus «يوم» must still leave room for the next-milestone stack. Countdown and «+1» need LTR isolation inside RTL text.
The greeting can still contradict the band (comeback over a streak held by tickets, utils.js:636-644) unless its priority changes together with this design.

Deleting a session silently rewrites the streak, because the value is derived (recovery.js:265-267). Without the delete-preview confirm and the number_changed note, a drop like 30→6 can happen again with no explanation.
The forecast copy («بكرة راحة بالخطة») must be computed from the cycle. A hard-coded or assumed version goes wrong after training on a rest day (recovery.js:151-152) or a frequency change.
Dates move from Hijri / Arabic-Indic (fmtDate ar-SA, utils.js:94-103) to Gregorian / Western on streak surfaces. If other surfaces stay Hijri, the app mixes calendars. One app-wide choice is needed.
Removing the commitment marks and the gold ticket chip changes two familiar visuals at once. The first launch could show a one-line coach mark on the band: «هنا الستريك: كل يوم وليش انحسب».
The design adds a sheet, a band and new copy. Without a shared todayStreakState selector, surfaces could drift apart again into the 'four streaks' problem the audit found.

designs.name: الشعلة الدائمة (Pilot Light): always on, rises only when there is something to lose
designs.thesis:
The owner said «يهمني موضوع الستريك يكون واضح», so the streak goes back into persistent chrome. A single chip in the global header shows it on every tab, including inside a workout (the header renders on every tab: App.jsx:769; screenshots/player-working.png). The chip is a real button that opens one streak sheet, so nothing about the streak is ever more than one tap away.

The chip always shows exactly two facts:
- The number, in Archivo #F97316.
- Today's state, carried by the flame: unlit outline means not counted yet, lit fill means counted.

It also has one status slot for the only things that change the meaning: a rest moon, a held ticket, or an hourglass with a countdown to 03:00. The chip escalates only inside the real danger window. That window is a workout day, not yet trained, no session running, and a miss that would actually cost something. The colour says what would be lost: a blue hourglass means a ticket goes, an orange hourglass means the streak breaks. The chip turns a tinted orange only after 00:00 with zero tickets. There is no looping animation; it gives one beat when it enters a state, then stays still.

The Today stage on Home gets one line attached directly under the green CTA. It says what today does to the number, for example «تمرّن اليوم ويصير الستريك 61». This replaces the collapsed row that sits fourth on the page (HomePage.jsx:274-304; state-credit-warning.png). It also fixes the false alarm: today the warning checks only !isRecoveryDay (HomePage.jsx:152-153).

Everything else becomes one definition with one name and one colour:
- The streak is eligible days (consistencyStreak, App.jsx:535), always called «الستريك».
- Tickets are always «تذاكر», shown in --rest blue.
- The protected state is always «محمي / واقف».
- The duplicate number and the 5-mark meter in the Home strip go (HomePage.jsx:208-236; constants.js:217-225).
- «تمارين متتالية» becomes cycle progress.
- The report and poster move to the same unit (monthReport.js:153-178; reportPoster.js:190).

The sheet answers "why this number" with an equation built from the existing ledger: trained days + plan rests, plus days covered by tickets that add 0, with every day drawn on a chained strip. A future 30→6 could then be understood without investigation, and any change to the number that is not a day passing gets announced once, with its reason.

placement.surface: Global header chip: every tab including Home, Workout, Exercises, Achievements, Profile and Settings (replaces the div at App.jsx:805-813)
placement.what:
A <button>, always rendered, including at 0. Today it hides at 0 (App.jsx:805), so a break goes silent.

Size and position:
- Height 32pt, min-width 64pt, radius 16pt.
- Hit area at least 44x44pt via 6pt transparent vertical padding.
- Background #14171B, 1pt hairline #282D33, padding-inline 10pt, gap 4pt.
- white-space:nowrap, which fixes today's wrap where the flame stacks over the 60 (page-home.png).
- It is the first item of the action cluster, 8pt before the timer button.

RTL order:
1. Phosphor Flame, 16pt. Regular weight (unlit, 1.5pt stroke) means today is not counted yet. Fill weight (lit) means today is counted.
2. The number: Archivo SemiCondensed 600, 18pt, tabular, #F97316, wrapped in an LTR isolate.
3. One status slot, 13pt, holding at most one glyph plus an optional Archivo 13pt/500 countdown in H:MM:
   - Moon fill, #3B9DE8: a scheduled rest.
   - Ticket fill, #3B9DE8, plus «×N» when N is 2 or more: the streak is held by consecutive paid days ending yesterday.
   - HourglassMedium with H:MM: from 21:00 to 03:00 on an untrained workout day. #3B9DE8 when a ticket would cover the miss, #F97316 when the streak would break.
   - A 6pt #F97316 dot: a session is running.

At streak 0 the flame and the «0» are #8A95A1, because nothing can be lost.

Critical form: after 00:00, no ticket, streak 1 or more. Background rgba(249,115,22,.14), 1.5pt #F97316 hairline, one 240ms scale beat (1 → 1.06 → 1) on entering, then still. The fill stays at 14% so the green CTA remains the screen's one lit action.

The aria-label is the full verdict sentence for the state, e.g. «الستريك 60، اليوم ما انحسب للحين، باقي 2:10 على 3 الفجر». Tap opens the streak sheet.

designs.explainer:
Streak sheet, «الستريك». A bottom sheet at 92% height: #14171B with a 1pt #282D33 top hairline, grab handle 36x4pt #282D33, 16pt gutters, sections separated by hairlines rather than boxes. It opens from the header chip, the Today verdict line, «هذا الأسبوع», the Profile block, the milestone overlay and streak notifications.

1. Hero
- Flame-stage glyph (20 / 28 / 36 / 44pt by stage) beside a 56pt Archivo 700 #F97316 numeral and «يوم» in Changa 17pt #B0B9C3.
- Under it, the same verdict text as Home in Changa 15pt, e.g. «اليوم ما انحسب للحين — تمرّن ويصير 61», so the sheet and the Home stage never disagree.
- Then «من الجمعة 9 مايو لين اليوم», from streakStart (recovery.js:272), in 13pt #8A95A1.

2. «ليش 60؟» (the answer, from inRun ledger rows)
Three rows. Numbers are right-aligned Archivo 20pt, labels Changa 15pt.
- «38» trained days (Flame fill #F97316): «يوم تمرّنت وحفظت الجلسة».
- «22» scheduled rests (Moon #3B9DE8): «راحة من خطتك — تنحسب لحالها».
- A 1pt hairline, then «= 60» in Archivo 600 #F97316.
- A muted fourth row: «8» ticket days (Ticket #3B9DE8): «أيام غطّتها تذاكر — توقف الستريك وما تزيده».
Footnote in 13pt #8A95A1: «عشان كذا الرقم 60 مو 68 — الأيام المغطّاة ما تنعد».
Today's row: «اليوم: يوم تمرين، ما انحسب للحين» (pending), or «اليوم: انحسب».

3. Days
A segmented control «الأسبوع / الشهر», Changa 13pt.
- Week: the same 7-cell chained strip as Home, at 44pt cells.
- Month: a 7-column grid of 40pt cells over the current run plus up to the previous break, using the same glyphs:
  - Trained: Flame fill #F97316.
  - Scheduled rest: Moon #3B9DE8.
  - Ticket: Ticket #3B9DE8 with a dashed blue chain.
  - Unpaid miss: slashed ring #8A95A1, chain cut.
  - Pending today: dashed outline flame.
  - Deload days: a 1pt #8A95A1 underline.
- Tapping a cell shows a one-line caption, e.g. «الثلاثاء 7 يوليو — يوم تمرين ما تمرّنت فيه، غطّته تذكرة (+0)», «السبت 4 يوليو — راحة من خطتك (+1)» or «الخميس 9 يوليو — يوم تمرين بلا تذكرة، هنا انكسر».
- Legend: one row of four glyphs with labels «تمرين +1 · راحة +1 · تذكرة +0 · غياب يكسر».

4. «التذاكر»
- A row of Ticket glyphs, 20pt, #3B9DE8, showing the TRUE usable count. Beyond 5, «+3» follows in Archivo.
- «التذكرة الجاية بعد 3 أيام» with a 2pt blue bar for 2 of 5 (creditProgress / daysToNextCredit).
- Rule in 13pt #B0B9C3: «كل 5 أيام محسوبة تعطيك تذكرة. إذا غبت يوم تمرين، تنصرف تذكرة لحالها: الستريك يوقف مكانه — ما يزيد وما ينكسر. إذا خلصت التذاكر وغبت، ينكسر والتذاكر ترجع صفر.»
- «انصرفت في هذا الستريك: 8», expandable to the list of dates from restTakenHistory inside the run.

5. «الأرقام»
- «أطول ستريك: 60 (الحالي)».
- «اللي قبله: 23 — من 3 أبريل لين 2 مايو، انكسر بالخميس 1 مايو».
- «المحطة الجاية: 75 · باقي 15».

6. «كيف ينحسب» (rules: 6 lines, Changa 14pt #B0B9C3, each with a 14pt glyph)
- «ينحسب اليوم إذا تمرّنت وحفظت الجلسة، أو إذا كان راحة في خطتك.»
- «اليوم يبدأ 3 الفجر وينتهي 3 الفجر — الجلسة تنحسب لليوم اللي بدأتها فيه، يعني جلسة 1 بالليل تنحسب لأمس.»
- «يوم تمرين بلا جلسة: تنصرف تذكرة. بلا تذاكر: ينكسر.»
- ««تخطي اليوم» يقدّم الخطة بس — اليوم يبقى يوم تمرين.»
- «الديلود يخفّف الأوزان بس — الغياب فيه ينحسب غياب.»
- «تغيير الخطة أو عدد الأيام: مرة كل 30 يوم ببلاش، والثانية تبدأ ستريك جديد · التغيير المجاني الجاي بعد 12 يوم», from changeCooldownLeft.

7. «تغيّرات على الرقم» (shown only if any)
Dated rows such as «8 يوليو 2026 — من 30 إلى 6 · استرجاع نسخة احتياطية» and «12 مارس — من 41 إلى 0 · غيّرت الخطة مرتين خلال 30 يوم», each linking to the affected days in the grid. This is the self-serve answer to the 30→6 incident.

8. «سجل يوم بيوم»
A text row that opens the plain-Arabic ledger: the full run, not the 20 rows today (RestLedgerPanel.jsx).
- Columns: «اليوم · المطلوب (تمرين/راحة) · اللي صار · النتيجة (+1 / +0 تذكرة / انكسر) · الستريك · التذاكر».
- Gregorian dates with Western digits, no English keys (restLedger.js:8-11).
- Includes «انسخ كنص».

Everything in sections 1–8 is derived from computeRecovery's ledger. The only stored additions are the change log and the best or previous run beyond the replay window.
designs.milestones:
One ladder: the existing STREAK_MILESTONES (7, 10, 14, 21, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 100, 120, 150, 180, 200, 250, 300, 365; utils.js:630), extended past 365 every 100. The 1/3/7/14/30 commitment marks and their five-colour tiers are removed (constants.js:217-225), and so is the earlier ember / flame / green-heart / light-heart proposal. Green means action and blue means rest in Floodlight, and the flame is the streak's only glyph.

Flame stage (the glyph beside the big numeral in the sheet, Profile, overlay and poster; never in the chip, whose flame only encodes today):
- 1–6: Flame at 20pt.
- 7–29: 28pt.
- 30–99: 36pt with an inner core: the same path at 55% scale, #F97316 at 100% over an outer layer at 45%.
- 100 and up: 44pt plus a 1pt #F97316 ring at 40%.
- 365 and up: the ring closes to a full circle.
All one colour, growing in size and heat.

Celebration tiers:
- Big (full-screen overlay once, 96pt numeral, «احفظ البوستر»): 7, 30, 60, 100, 200, 365, then every 100.
- Small (the Today verdict line shows «وصلت 14 — المحطة الجاية 21» with one 240ms flame beat, no overlay): every other milestone.

Trigger: the first render where consistencyStreak equals a milestone that is greater than the last celebrated one. That happens in two ways:
- Right after finishSession on a workout day, replacing the toast.
- On the first open after 03:00 on a scheduled rest day, because a rest day adds +1 with no action. The overlay title then reads «30 يوم ستريك — وصلتها اليوم وأنت مرتاح».

Overlay copy: title «N يوم ستريك», breakdown «من 9 يونيو: 15 تمرين و15 راحة من خطتك», foot «المحطة الجاية 40».

The achievement badges (c1–c6 at 3/7/14/30/60/100, constants.js:792-822) stay as achievements. When one unlocks on a milestone day, it rides the same overlay as a second line, «وانفتح وسام شهر الالتزام», instead of a separate popup.

The sheet and Profile always show «المحطة الجاية N · باقي M».

The streak poster (96pt) is the shareable form of a big milestone.
designs.notifications:
Replace the state-blind evening slot with at most ONE streak reminder per training day, plus at most one morning-after line. Today the 21:00 message «هل أكملت تمرينك اليوم؟» fires even on trained and rest days (utils.js:512-518; constants.js:1040-1048).

Streak reminder. It fires only if all of these hold: today is a workout day, there is no saved session today, no session is running, and streak ≥1. Timing and copy depend on the balance:
- No ticket: at 00:00 (3h before the turn).
  Title «الستريك 60 على المحك».
  Body «باقي 3 ساعات — ابدأ جلستك قبل 3 الفجر».
- Ticket available: at 01:00, softer.
  Title «ما تمرّنت اليوم».
  Body «لو ما بدأت قبل 3 الفجر، تنصرف تذكرة والستريك يوقف على 60 (يبقى 3)».
- The reminder is cancelled the moment today counts.

Morning after (on first open, or 09:00 if scheduled):
- After an auto-spend: «انصرفت تذكرة عن أمس — الستريك محمي على 60، باقي 3».
- After a break: «انكسر الستريك عند 60 — اليوم يبدأ من جديد».

Never send on scheduled-rest or already-counted days. Never use 🔥 in non-streak notifications (constants.js:1010, 1033). Each notification uses tag 'streak' so a newer one replaces the older, and tapping it opens the streak sheet.

Delivery honesty: the current scheduler uses setTimeout and fires only while the page is alive (utils.js:521-537), and the app has no server. So the 00:00 reminder is reliable only if he opened the app that evening. The design therefore does not depend on it:
- The chip's countdown, the critical tint and the app icon badge (navigator.setAppBadge(1) set on visibilitychange→hidden when a break is possible) carry the at-risk signal.
- Real Web Push to the installed PWA needs a tiny sender holding his push subscription and next deadline. That is listed as new infrastructure, not promised in copy.

In-app toast for a ticket spend: anchored under the header, never covering the chip (copy in placement).
newData: todayState selector, derived and not stored: from the last ledger row plus balance, return {counted: streakDelta===1 && inRun, kind: 'trained'|'rest'|'paid'|'pending'|'reset', missCost: usable>=1 ? 'ticket' : (streak>=1 ? 'break' : 'none'), deadline: nextDayTurn()} (recovery.js:278-315; day.js:50-55). This drives the chip, the verdict line, the badge and notifications, and replaces HomePage's atRisk (HomePage.jsx:152-153), which today fires after training and on override days and is silent for streaks 1–4.

usableCredits = creditsEarned − creditsSpent (uncapped), exposed and used for every displayed ticket count instead of the display-clamped restCredits (recovery.js:239 vs 312, 318). Plus a plural helper: «تذكرة وحدة / تذكرتين / 3 تذاكر / 11 تذكرة». Delete the false 'full balance يضيع' tip (monthReport.js:640). Do NOT make the cap real retroactively (see risks).
heldDays: the count of consecutive 'paid' ledger rows ending yesterday, for the chip's Ticket ×N and «آخر 8 أيام غطّتها التذاكر».

runBreakdown: counts of inRun ledger rows split into trained, scheduled rest and paid, plus calendar span. This is the sheet's «ليش 60؟» equation. Derivable from ledger fields completed / scheduled / kind.

Active-session day treated as pending: pass dayKey(hf_active.date) into computeRecovery so that day is treated like today (never a miss, never auto-paid) while a session started before 03:00 is still running. Skip the auto-spend effect's writes and toast while active (App.jsx:505-530). Without this, at 03:00 mid-session the chip would flash a break or auto-spend and the toast «استُخدم يوم راحة…» would fire falsely, even though the session (stamped at start, App.jsx:367, 392) later counts.

Run history and true best in eligible days: record each restart in the forward walk (recovery.js:225-229) as {start, end, length, endedBy: 'miss'|'settings', date}. Persist hf_streak_best {value, start, end} and the previous run so they survive the 400-day replay window. This replaces bestStreak = streak (ProfilePage.jsx:72) and supplies «انكسر عند 60» copy (brokenBy exists at recovery.js:330, the broken run's length does not).

hf_streak_seen {value, dayKey, at} plus hf_streak_changes [{at, from, to, reason}]: compare each recompute with the last seen value. Any change other than day-passing (+1 at a turn, +1 on a save, 0 on a recorded break) logs an entry. The reason comes from the triggering action: setRecoveryCfg from Settings → 'settings', backup import (App.jsx:986-990) → 'import', history restore report (App.jsx:92-96) → 'restore', else 'unknown'.
hf_streak_celebrated: the last milestone value shown, so the overlay fires once even when the milestone is reached at 03:00 on a rest day.

Report and poster streak in eligible-day units: the month-end streak, the best run within the month, and the all-time best, computed from the recovery ledger instead of session dates (monthReport.js:163-181; Consistency.jsx:66-74; reportPoster.js:190). Correct the false comments at monthReport.js:153-157 and Consistency.jsx:66-68.
Optional one-day forward projection, tomorrowKind (rest/workout), for «بكرة راحة» after training. The engine stops at today. If not built, the copy falls back to «يومك محسوب، ارتاح».
Gregorian date formatter with Western digits for every streak date (toasts, sheet, ledger, notices), replacing fmtDate 'ar-SA' Hijri with Arabic-Indic digits for these (utils.js:94-103).

Notification plumbing: a state-aware 'streak' slot computed from todayState, replacing the fixed evening slot (utils.js:512-518), plus navigator.setAppBadge / clearAppBadge on visibilitychange. True background delivery would need a Web Push sender (subscription + deadline), which does not exist today.
Lift the 400-day replay cap (recovery.js:131-133), or persist a run checkpoint, before the streak can pass about 401. Otherwise the 365 milestone is the last one the engine can represent.
risks: Retroactive rules are the 30→6 trap. Because every number is replayed from history, making MAX_REST_CREDITS a real cap (stop earning at 5) would rewrite past days and break existing streaks on deploy. The veteran fixture's 8 absorbed misses would break at the 6th. Any cap change must apply only from a dated capFrom, like autoSpendFrom, and the number-changed log must catch it if anything moves.

Countdown fatigue. He trains late because the gym closes at 3, so a countdown from 21:00 will show on many training nights. It is informational only (no tint) until 00:00, and only orange when the streak would actually break. If it still feels like nagging, start the window from his workoutTime setting instead of a fixed 21:00.

Header width at 390pt. The countdown form of the chip (about 125pt) plus the timer and settings buttons leaves about 150pt for the greeting, which will wrap to two lines on late nights. Test with the longest greeting and three-digit streaks, and if it is tight, drop the greeting's second line or the timer label first, never the chip.

Two blues, two meanings. Moon (scheduled rest, +1) and Ticket (held, +0) are both --rest #3B9DE8. They are separated by glyph and by chain style (solid vs dashed), not by colour. The sheet's «ليش 60؟» rows and the legend must ship together, or the +1 vs +0 difference will be missed exactly as Duolingo users missed freeze vs miss shades.
Changing the report and poster unit makes old numbers jump (e.g. March 16 → 31). Without the one-time note «صار الستريك في التقرير نفس رقم الشاشة الرئيسية» this repeats the original shock in reverse.

The session-across-03:00 fix is a hard dependency. Ship the chip escalation and the 'broken' state without the active-session pending fix, and he can see «انكسر» or a ticket-spend toast mid-set at 03:00 for a session that will count once saved.

Notifications cannot be promised. Without a push sender they fire only if the app was alive that evening. All at-risk information must also exist in the chip, the verdict line and the app badge, and no copy may say «بنذكّرك».

«One lit moment» tension. In the critical window the tinted orange chip and the green CTA both draw the eye. Keep the chip at 14% tint (never solid) and the beat single, so the action stays the lit element.

The greeting pool must be reordered (utils.js:636-644): held or at-risk lines before deload and comeback, and comeback only after an actual break. Otherwise the header sentence will keep contradicting the chip («الغياب انتهى» beside a ticket-held 60).

The deload truth disappoints the owner. His brief believes deload protects the streak, but the code says it does not (deload.js:3-4). The design states it plainly («الغياب فيه ينحسب غياب») rather than changing the engine. If he wants deload to protect the streak, that is a rules change with retroactive-replay risk and needs a dated start.
There is no back-dating UI (no date input in src). The sheet must not promise «أضف الجلسة بتاريخها ويرجع الستريك», even though the replayed engine would honour a back-dated session.

scores.rationale: This design passes the 2-second test best, and it answers the owner's complaint that the old placement was «too quiet». The number is a 96pt orange numeral at the top of Home. It never appears without a status line, a 03:00 deadline with a live countdown (nextDayTurn, day.js:50-55), and a cost line («لو فاتك: تنصرف تذكرة ويوقف على 60 (يبقى 3)»). All of that sits in one block, so length, whether today is safe, what to do and by when are read together. Today's state is shown two ways: an outline or filled flame, and the cone that lights only once today has counted. A 7-day chain cut at a miss shows why in pictures. The «ليش 60؟» sheet gives the sum (30 تمرين + 30 راحة = 60, 8 days held by tickets, 69 calendar days). It also has a «وش تغيّر» log, so a 30→6 drop explains itself. That is the exact failure the owner went through. The silent break is gone: today the header pill is hidden at 0 (App.jsx:805 `streak > 0 &&`); the design shows an outline 0 and a dated band instead. It removes the false at-risk alarm, because the current check only tests !isRecoveryDay (HomePage.jsx:152-153). It treats deload, «تخطي اليوم» and the automatic ticket spend honestly. It also covers the hard edge cases: a session that crosses 03:00 is shown as provisional, there is a finish guard for an empty session, and a delete confirm previews the effect on the streak. Weaknesses: the 242pt scoreboard pushes the CTA down to about y=500. Stacked flame badges (moon, ticket, hourglass) on a flame that also grows by stage are a lot to read at a glance. The chain shows glyphs but no per-day deltas. The late-window hourglass is always orange, even when a ticket would cover the miss.

Its structure is close to the Scoreboard, and it adds one clear win for clarity: every cell in the 7-day strip carries its delta (+1 orange, 0 blue, «كسر» grey). So «why is it 60» can be read on Home without tapping, and a frozen run reads plainly as a row of zeros. Other good choices: the next milestone (75 · باقي 15) sits in the band; the real ticket count shows as filled slots plus «+3»; the consequence line is attached to the Today stage under the CTA; the header chip never hides at 0; there is a rule that nothing may be inserted between the header and the band. Its sheet opens with the cause of the run's start («بدأ الأحد 9 أغسطس — بعد غياب السبت 8 أغسطس بدون تذكرة»), which is the most direct answer to a sudden drop. The 56px numeral is visible but smaller than the Scoreboard's. Today's facts are split between Row B and the stage line, so the 03:00 deadline is not next to the number before 21:00. Five ticket slots next to the number risk reading as a second meter. The flame no longer shows tiers, which the owner may miss.

Its strongest point is a persistent, state-carrying chip on every tab, including the workout screen. It is never hidden at 0. Colour encodes what a miss would cost: a blue hourglass means a ticket goes, an orange one means the streak breaks, which is the most precise «is today safe» signal of the three. It adds a verdict line directly under the CTA. Its sheet has the clearest one-line answer to the count, «عشان كذا الرقم 60 مو 68 — الأيام المغطّاة ما تنعد», plus a «previous run» record. Its risk analysis is the sharpest of the three: making MAX_REST_CREDITS a real cap would replay history and break existing streaks (recovery.js:239 vs 318). That would repeat the 30→6 shock, so the design requires a dated capFrom. But under this lens it is still too quiet. On Home the number is an 18pt chip in the header, and the screenshot shows today's pill already wrapping («🔥» stacked over «60», page-home.png). An outline-versus-filled flame at 16pt, with a 13pt status glyph and a blue or orange hourglass, cannot be decoded in 2 seconds. The week chapter sits below the stage, which repeats the earlier placement the owner rejected. In the critical window the tinted chip also competes with the green CTA.

scores.rationale: This design best meets both the truthfulness lens and the owner's new clarity demand. The 96pt numeral at the top of Home never appears without a sentence saying what today does to it and by when. Every state comes from the last ledger rows, and I checked the critical cases in the code. On an override day, expected stays RECOVERY, so kindOf returns 'eligible' and streakDelta is 1 (recovery.js:236-237, 295-304). Keying 'counted' off the ledger rather than off status is therefore correct, and it removes both false alarms from atRisk (HomePage.jsx:152-153). Today's row is pending, never a miss (recovery.js:241, 291), so «لين 3 الفجر» and «ابدأ قبل 3 — الجلسة تنحسب لليوم اللي بدأتها فيه» are true. Naming the training day between 00:00 and 03:00 («باقي تمرين يوم الثلاثاء») is the most precise deadline copy of the three. The sum (trained + plan rest = streak, paid shown as +0, today pending, 69 calendar days) partitions inRun rows exactly. The break band, the reset band, «التذاكر راحت مع الستريك» (restart() zeroes earned and spent, recovery.js:229) and the delete preview are all faithful to the code. It handles the session that crosses 03:00 by not displaying or toasting that day's spend or break. That is enough: once the session is saved, trained wins in kindOf, so the restDays row the effect wrote (App.jsx:505-530) does not change the number. Weak points: (1) It shows «أفضل ستريك 60 — محفوظ» and Profile best before runs[] or hf_streak_best exist. (2) It offers milestones 'every 100 after 365' although the replay is capped at today−400 (recovery.js:131-133). (3) It says only 'decide' on the ticket cap, without warning that a real cap would rewrite history on replay. (4) It is the largest build: hero, sheet, change log, milestone takeover and header-chip fade-in.

The copy is very honest, and it has the best on-Home 'why'. Every strip cell carries its delta (+1 for trained or plan rest, 0 for a ticket, كسر for a break), so the arithmetic is visible without a tap. I verified «لو تمرّنت، الراحة تنتقل لبكرة» on override days: a trained day does consecutive += 1 whatever expected was (recovery.js:151-152). The sheet's start-cause line («بدأ … بعد غياب … بدون تذكرة») is true, because restart(i) sets the run start to the day after the miss (recovery.js:229). It stages unproven data honestly: Profile best stays hidden until runs[] exist, forecast copy falls back without tomorrowExpected, and 'every 100 after 365' is withheld because of the 400-day cap. Its milestones (7/14/30/60/100) line up with badges c2–c6. Main truthfulness gap: it never handles the session that crosses 03:00. At 03:01 the previous day is replayed as a miss, so mid-workout the always-visible header chip would go grey «0», or a ticket toast would fire. The player says «تنحسب لأمس» right next to it, a contradiction at the worst moment. The 56pt number is clear but smaller than the Scoreboard's. Hiding the chip on Home depends on an ordering rule that is easy to break later.

The engineering truth is the strongest of the three. It alone specifies the full fix for the session that crosses 03:00: treat dayKey(hf_active.date) as pending, and skip the auto-spend effect's restDays write and its toast while a session is active (App.jsx:505-530). It alone warns that making MAX_REST_CREDITS a real cap would retroactively break existing streaks on deploy, because everything is replayed (recovery.js:239 vs 318), and it proposes a dated capFrom. Its hourglass is coloured by cost: blue when a ticket would cover the miss, orange when the streak would break. That is the most truthful at-a-glance risk signal, and the critical tint is reserved for 'no ticket, after 00:00'. «عشان كذا الرقم 60 مو 68» explains frozen days precisely, and the app badge is an honest stand-in for push. But against the owner's «يهمني … يكون واضح», Home has no large streak number: only an 18pt header chip, plus an inline «61» in the verdict line, and the week chapter repeats no number. That is close to the 'too quiet' problem the owner just rejected. The single status slot also has to choose between moon, ticket ×N, hourglass and the session dot when several apply, and no priority order is given.

Have the auto-spend effect (App.jsx:505-530) write nothing to restDays and push no «استُخدم يوم راحة» toast during an active session. Hiding the display alone still leaves the header chip and ticket count wrong mid-workout.

scores.rationale: Best on clarity and the most thorough answer to 'why this number'. The sum includes calendar days («= 69 يوم من 1 مايو. الستريك مو أيام التقويم ولا عدد الجلسات»), which directly answers the 30→6 history. It has the best state copy, a finish guard for empty sessions, provisional handling for sessions that cross 03:00, and a delete preview. Its lit rule is the most disciplined statement of Floodlight in any of the three: the cone shows only when today has counted and no green action is on screen, and the flame is an outline while today is owed. It still breaks Floodlight in daily use. The numeral is a 96pt #F97316 figure that is 'always #F97316 and never recoloured by state', so on every owed workout day a 96pt orange block sits directly above the green CTA. That is two loud elements, and the design names this risk itself. It also spends the poster/takeover scale (96) on the everyday Home view, which flattens the milestone moment. The scoreboard is about 242pt tall and holds an eyebrow, numeral, status, a two-line deadline/cost block and a chain. That pushes the Today stage down to y≈500pt and makes Home a streak screen rather than a training screen. Using one number for tickets rather than slots is the right call.

The best fit with Floodlight while still treating clarity as first-class. The streak is the first block under the header, so it is visible without being the hero. The numeral uses the system's own 56px display scale (A uses the 96 poster scale). The green CTA stays the screen's one lit action, and the band becomes the lit moment only on a milestone day when no green CTA is shown. A filled or outline flame shows whether today has counted. The strip's per-day deltas (+1 orange, 0 blue ticket, «كسر» grey, chain cut on a break) answer 'why 60' without a tap. Next to today's pill, which carries no state, and the five droplets that read like credits (page-home.png: «60» with five green marks, a gold «4» ticket chip in the hero, and the comeback greeting beside a held 60), this removes the duplication and the colour drift. The consequence line moves from a separate red box, 4th on the page (state-credit-warning.png), into the Today stage. It also fixes the at-risk false alarm, unifies the 1–4 versus ≥5 threshold, adds the «تخطي اليوم» confirm and the delete preview, and moves the report and poster to the same unit. Weaknesses: the band is dense (a next-milestone stack, a sentence, 7 cells each with label, glyph, delta and chain, a deload bracket, and a 5-slot ticket row with «+3»), and the slot row puts a five-mark meter back beside the number. In the late window it turns both Row B and the stage line orange. It hides the header chip on Home with no fallback once the band scrolls away. It sends up to 2 reminders a day. The milestone copy uses a 🔥 emoji, which clashes with the Phosphor-only icon rule. It drops flame growth entirely. It never flags that a session crossing 03:00 can trigger a false auto-spend or break.

It respects one lit moment best. The streak is a quiet chip on every tab, it escalates only in the window where something can be lost, and the hourglass colour says what would be lost (blue means a ticket covers the miss, orange means a break). The critical tint stays at 14%, so the green CTA remains the lit element. Two ideas are the strongest in the set. First, the verdict line sits immediately under the green CTA, so it reads as the action's consequence. Second, flame stage growth is shown only in the sheet, Profile, overlay and poster, while the live chip flame only says whether today has counted. Its risk list is also the most mature: it warns that a retroactive MAX_REST_CREDITS cap would itself repeat the 30→6 shock, and it says the session-crossing-03:00 fix is a hard dependency. Its weakness is the owner's actual request. Home has no large streak numeral; the number is an 18pt figure in a 32pt chip, and the 'هذا الأسبوع' strip still sits below the stage, close to the placement the owner just called too quiet. The chip carries four jobs (number, today state, a status glyph, a ticking H:MM countdown from 21:00). That crowds a header the design itself measures as leaving about 150pt for the greeting, and a countdown on most late training nights leans toward nagging.

issues.where: newData: usableCredits; placement (أ) ticket count; header chip «×N»
issues.problem: The spec says to show earned − spent with no clamping at all. The engine charges every restDays entry on a workout day with no balance check, so earned − spent can go below zero. Because the auto-spend effect writes paid days into restDays, deleting an earlier session is enough to trigger this. The scoreboard would then show a negative ticket count. The «×2» held-days badge would also sit on a streak of 0, because the new run now 'starts' on paid days.
issues.evidence: recovery.js:200-203 and 241-242 (a 'paid' day always does spent++); App.jsx:527 writes autoPaidDays into restDays permanently. Repro: sessions on Jul 1,3,5,7,9 with daysPerWeek 3 auto-pay Jul 11 and 12. After persisting those and deleting the Jul 9 session, computeRecovery gives creditsEarned 0, creditsSpent 2 (usable −2), consistencyStreak 0, streakStart 2026-07-11, restCredits 0.
issues.fix: Drop the 5 cap but floor the count at 0: max(0, earned − spent). Add a state for a run held only by paid days with streak 0, with copy and no «×N» badge. Add a test where a persisted paid day ends up in a run that has no balance.

issues.where: states.broken_restart; explainer «الرقم وبدايته» (startCause); newData.startCause; break copy «انكسر ستريك 60 يوم — <day>»
issues.problem: brokenBy is the most recent unpaid miss, not the day that ended the previous run. If two or more workout days in a row are missed with no tickets, the copy names the wrong day. Also, right after a break streakStart is null until today counts, so the test 'brokenBy == day before streakStart' cannot run, and the start cause comes out empty or wrong.
issues.evidence: recovery.js:329-330 (brokenBy = last item of missedDays) and 238-240 (each later miss restarts again). Repro: sessions on Jul 1 and 3 (pattern [1]), Jul 5 and 6 missed, today Jul 7. Result: brokenBy 2026-07-06, missedDays [07-05, 07-06], streakStart null, streak 0. The 4-day run was broken on Jul 5.
issues.fix: Record the break day and the length of the ended run in the forward walk, at the first restart that ends a non-empty run, and take break copy and startCause from that. Do not derive startCause from streakStart while today is still pending.

issues.where: newData.runs[]; implementation recovery.js «runs[] recorded inside the forward walk at restart, lines 225-229»; profile «أطول ستريك»; sheet «السلسلة اللي قبله» endedBy:'settings'
issues.problem: A run that a settings reset cut short cannot be recorded at restart(i). Line 235 calls restart(i) for every day up to and including streakResetAt, so the days before the reset never build up into a run in that walk. As written, endedBy:'settings' and the length of the pre-reset run are not available, and neither is any best taken from them. That walk also does not count streak units, and back-to-back misses would produce zero-length runs.
issues.evidence: recovery.js:235: `if (resetAt && e.date <= resetAt) { restart(i); continue }`. recovery.js:224-246 tracks only earned/spent/progress, and progress resets every 5.
issues.fix: Work out runs in a separate pass that ignores resetAt and cuts at resetAt with endedBy:'settings'. Count only rows where streakDelta === 1, and drop empty runs. Persist hf_streak_best before applyFrequencyChange/applyPlanChange writes streakResetAt (App.jsx:727 and 741).

issues.where: Report block «آخر الشهر 60» (endStreak, monthReport.js:267) and the poster tile «الستريك 60»
issues.problem: endStreak is computed as if the month's last day were today. The report window opens 2 days before month end, so on the 30th of a 31-day month the real today counts as a past day. The report then shows a spent ticket, or a broken streak, that Home does not show. This is the kind of two-number shock the redesign is meant to remove.
issues.evidence: monthReport.js:210-211 calls computeRecovery(sessions, config, lastDay); REPORT_WINDOW_TAIL = 2 (monthReport.js:57, 66). Repro with the clock on 2026-10-30, sessions on Oct 26 and 28 (pattern [1]): Home consistencyStreak 4, buildMonthReport endStreak 0, brokenBy 2026-10-30 (today). With a balance it auto-pays today instead (restCredits 5 on Home, 4 in the report).
issues.fix: Compute the report streak with today = min(lastDay, todayKey()), and label it «لين اليوم» while the month is still running. Apply the same fix to the report's missedDays and calendar.

issues.where: howItCounts #3 (empty session); WorkoutPlayer finish guard «إذا كانت normalizeSession سترجع null»
issues.problem: Planned sessions come pre-filled with the suggested weight and reps. normalizeSession marks every filled set as done when nothing is ticked. So pressing «إنهاء التمرين» on an untouched planned workout saves a full session and counts the day for the streak. The proposed guard never fires there. The spec's rule makes it sound as if a session where nothing was done cannot count.
issues.evidence: App.jsx:359-363 (prevWeight and suggestedReps go into buildExercise); utils.js:295-299 and 384 (blankSet fills weight and reps); sets.js:44-56 (no ticks → keep sets that have numbers and mark them done). Repro: normalizeSession on buildExercise({prevWeight:'80', prevReps:10}) with nothing ticked returns 3 sets, all done=true.
issues.fix: Base the guard on zero ticked sets, not on normalizeSession returning null. Example copy: «ما أشّرت ولا مجموعة — نحفظ الأوزان المقترحة كأنك سويتها؟» Update the rule text to match.

issues.where: howItCounts last row («الحسبة تعيد آخر 400 يوم بس»); startCause 'windowEdge'; «وش تغيّر»; «يبقى مدفوع إلى الأبد»
issues.problem: The 400-day cap does more than limit the streak to about 401. Once history is older than 400 days, the replay starts the cycle from scratch at the window edge (consecutive 0, position 0). That creates misses on days the user never missed. A user who followed the plan perfectly sees the streak drop back to about 395, again and again, and brokenBy names a date he did not miss. The proposed startCause and change log would report this as a real 'miss'. restDays is also cut to the last 120 entries, so «paid forever» is not guaranteed.
issues.evidence: recovery.js:131-139 (cursor = today − 400, cycle state reset). Simulation (daysPerWeek 5, training every planned day for 520 days): the streak goes up to 401, then drops to 395 every 7 days, with brokenBy 2025-01-07, 2025-01-14 and so on. App.jsx:527 uses `.slice(-120)`.
issues.fix: Treat a brokenBy within one cycle of the window start as 'windowEdge', and never as a miss, in copy or in hf_streak_changes. Plan to widen the window or seed the cycle state before Hamza's history reaches 400 days. Soften «إلى الأبد».

issues.where: TodayHero «تخطي اليوم» confirm sheet copy

On a «أبي أتمرّن» day (a scheduled rest the user overrode), the engine has already counted the rest, and TodayHero still shows «تخطي اليوم». Yet the sheet would say «الستريك لسا يبي تمرين اليوم… تنصرف تذكرة / يرجع 60 إلى صفر». That is a false alarm.

issues.fix: Branch the skip copy on todayStreak.counted. If the day is counted: «تخطي اليوم ينقل الخطة بس — اليوم محسوب لك». Use the warning only when the kind is 'owed'.
